upgrade_ammo_scavenger_desc.text:
Any time you secure or deny a Soul from an entity you get ammo back and gain stacking Spirit Power.
At Max Stacks, gain bonus Sprint speed

upgrade_lifestrike_gauntlets_desc.text:
Your next Melee attack heals you.

This heal is {s:NonHeroHealPct}% effective vs non-heroes.
Cooldown is {s:LightMeleeCooldownMult}x as long for Light Melee hits.

upgrade_chain_lightning_desc.text: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

upgrade_targeted_silence_desc.text:
Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage.

Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.

upgrade_proc_silence_desc.text: Your bullets build up to a Silence. Victims are immune to the build up for {s:ImmunityDuration}s after silence expires.

upgrade_proc_silence_debuff_desc.text: Your bullets reduce the target's outgoing spirit damage.

upgrade_silencer_active.text: For the next {s:AbilityDuration}s, all your bullets immediately apply Silence. Silence prevents targets from using abilities.

upgrade_slowing_bullets_desc.text: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

upgrade_inhibitor_desc.text: Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction.

upgrade_bullet_armor_reduction_aura_desc.text: Reduces nearby enemies' Bullet Resist and Fire Rate. If there is only one enemy hero nearby, this effect is doubled.

upgrade_dps_aura_active_desc.text: Provides {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MoveSpeed'} and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'FireRate'} to you and nearby allies. Minions get double value.

upgrade_dps_aura_desc.text: Provides Bullet Resist to nearby friendly units.

upgrade_warp_stone_desc.text: Teleport straight ahead, gaining Bullet Resist.

upgrade_tech_damage_pulse_desc.text: Periodically deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} to the closest two enemies nearby.

upgrade_magic_burst_desc.text: Charges up over time with {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusSpiritDamage'}, causing abilities dealing more than {s:MinimumDamage} damage to deal additional damage.

upgrade_magic_shock_desc.text: Charges up over time with {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusSpiritDamage'}, causing abilities dealing more than {s:MinimumDamage} damage to deal additional damage. Ignores Spirit Resistance.

upgrade_tech_bleed_desc.text: Imbue an ability with Lifesteal and to apply slow on a hit target and deal an additional percentage of the damage dealt to enemies around the target after a short delay.

upgrade_toxic_bullets_desc.text: Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also applies Healing Reduction on the bleeding target.

upgrade_weighted_shots_desc.text: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

upgrade_tech_overflow_desc.text: Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting enemy heroes.

upgrade_ricochet_desc.text: Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.

upgrade_close_range_desc.text: Deal additional Weapon Damage when in close range to your target.

upgrade_long_range_desc.text: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

upgrade_ethereal_bullets_desc.text: Your imbued ability charges up over time with {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusSpiritDamage'}, {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusFireRate'}, and reloads bullets on use. Until your next reload, your bullets deal {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusSpiritDamage'} based on your Spirit Power.

upgrade_medic_bullets_desc.text: Your next bullet will heal you based on what target you hit.

upgrade_close_quarter_combat_desc.text: When in close range to your target, gain Weapon Damage and your bullets apply a Movement Slow.

upgrade_headshot_booster_desc.text: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusWeaponDamage'}.

upgrade_headshot_booster2_desc.text: Landing a Headshot reduces their Bullet Resist.

upgrade_sharpshooter_desc.text: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

upgrade_headhunter_desc.text: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusWeaponDamage'}, {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Heal'} you, and briefly grants {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusMoveSpeed'}.

upgrade_spellslinger_headshots_part1_des.text: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.

upgrade_spellslinger_headshots_part2_des.text: Landing headshots against the target reduces their Spirit Resist further.

upgrade_banshee_slugs_headshots_desc.text: Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet and Spirit Resist and applies Healing Reduction.

upgrade_berserker_desc.text: Your Weapon Damage increases as you take sustained damage.

upgrade_fervor_passive.text: While you are below {s:LowHealthThreshold}% health, you gain stat bonuses for a duration and existing debuffs on you are reduced.

upgrade_tech_defense_shredders_desc.text: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.

upgrade_hollow_point_rounds_desc.text: When you are above {s:LifeThreshold}% health, deal additional Weapon Damage and your bullets reduce enemy Bullet Resist.

upgrade_pristine_emblem_desc.text: Your attacks have additional Weapon Damage against enemies above {s:EnemyLifeThreshold}% health.

upgrade_glass_cannon_desc.text: Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of {s:MaxStacks} times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.

upgrade_fury_trance_active.text: Grants Fire Rate, Spirit Resistance and Move Speed, and removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting, but Silences you and disables stamina usage and regeneration.

upgrade_surging_power_active.text: Grants Lifesteal, Fire Rate, and Ammo. This added Ammo is not limited by your max magazine size.

upgrade_siphon_bullets_desc_passive2.text: Your bullets temporarily steal Max HP from enemies. Enemies regain their stolen health when the debuff expires.

upgrade_boxing_glove_desc.text:
Your Melee Attack applies Movement Slow and heals you for a percentage of the Melee Damage dealt plus a fixed amount.

This heal is {s:NonHeroHealPct}% effective vs non-heroes.
Cooldown is {s:LightMeleeCooldownMult}x as long for Light Melee hits.

upgrade_burst_fire_desc.text: Briefly gain Fire Rate and Move Speed when one of your bullets hits an enemy hero.

upgrade_intensifying_clip_desc.text: Increases Weapon Damage as you continuously fire your weapon.

upgrade_reinforcing_casings_desc.text: Grants Bullet Resist when your bullets hit an enemy hero. Each shot can only grant one stack.

upgrade_critshot_desc.text:
Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit.
Bonus damage cannot Crit.

upgrade_veil_walker_desc.text: Walking through a cosmic veil grants you Stealth, Heal and increased Move Speed.

upgrade_glass_cannon2_desc.text: Each hero kill grants permanent Weapon Damage (up to a max of {s:MaxStacks} times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.

upgrade_split_shot_desc.text:
Make your weapon fire multishot.

Hitting more than one Hero per attack will grant a stacking weapon damage bonus.

Targets can only be hit once per multishot.

upgrade_blood_tribute_desc.text: Toggle: Continually sacrifice Health to improve {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'FireRate'}, Debuff Resistance and Move Speed.

upgrade_non_player_bonus_sacrifice_desc.text: Target an enemy NPC and consume it for {s:BonusSoulsPct}% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.

upgrade_capacitor_desc.text: Launch a projectile that deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritIcon'}damage, applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities.

upgrade_enchanted_holsters_desc.text:
While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed.
Each stack refreshes the duration.

upgrade_weapon_backstabber_desc.text:
Dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'WeaponDamage'} at close range opens a wound and grants you {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusMoveSpeed'}.

Wounded enemies take {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDPS'}, have reduced {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BulletResist'}, and are revealed through walls.

upgrade_express_shot_desc.text: Your next attack will fire twice in quick succession with increased damage and velocity. This attack consumes extra ammo.

upgrade_melee_charge_desc.text: Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage.

upgrade_crushing_fists_desc.text:
Your {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MeleeDamage'} will restore ammo and apply a stacking bullet resist debuff on enemies. Heavy melee applies 2 stacks.

If the target reaches max stacks, they will be stunned.

upgrade_mystic_regeneration_desc.text: Dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} to enemy Heroes grants you Bonus {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Regen'}. Stacks when dealing damage to different heroes.

upgrade_magic_vulnerability_desc.text: When an enemy takes {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}, they have their {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritResist'} reduced.

upgrade_healbane_desc.text: Your {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} applies Healing Reduction. If an enemy hero dies under this effect, you receive a large heal.

upgrade_magic_slow_desc.text: When the target takes {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}, they have their Move Speed reduced.

upgrade_escalating_exposure_desc.text: Dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} applies a stacking Spirit Amp that increases your {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} to the target.

upgrade_magic_reach_desc.text: Imbue an ability to increase its range and effect radius.

upgrade_tech_range_desc.text: Increases the range and effect radius of your abilities and items.

upgrade_magic_tempo_desc.text: Imbue an ability to reduce its Cooldown.

upgrade_cooldown_reduction_desc.text: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities.

upgrade_transcendent_cooldown_desc.text: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities and items.

BonusSpiritForChargedAbilities_label.text: Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities

BonusSpiritForChargedAbilities_postvalue.text: Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities

upgrade_thermal_detonator_desc.text:
Throw a flask that explodes on contact, creating an area that does increasing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} per second and reduces enemy Bullet Resist.

{s:NonHeroReductionPercent}% less effective vs non-heroes.

upgrade_fleetfoot_boots_active_desc.text: Gain bonus Move Speed and Slow Resistance.

upgrade_fleetfoot_boots_passive_desc.text: Removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting.

upgrade_kinetic_sash_desc.text: When you Dash-Jump you gain Fire Rate and bonus Ammo until your next reload. Lasts up to {s:AbilityDuration}s.

upgrade_arcane_surge_desc.text: After you Dash-Jump, the next ability you use within {s:ArcaneSurgeWindow}s will have bonus Range, Duration, and Spirit Power.

upgrade_active_reload_desc.text: While reloading, pressing {g:citadel_binding:'Reload'} during the highlighted portion will instantly finish your reload and grant you Fire Rate, Bullet Lifesteal and Move Speed.

upgrade_containment_desc.text:
Slows movement of enemy target. Also Silences their movement-based items and abilities.
Increases the target's gravity.
Does not affect target's stamina usage.

upgrade_spirit_sap_desc.text: Target an enemy to reduce their Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.

upgrade_focus_lens_desc.text: Target an enemy to Silence them. A portion of all damage dealt during the silence gets applied to the target when the silence wears off.

upgrade_withering_whip_desc.text: Target an enemy to reduce their Fire Rate and Bullet Resistance.

upgrade_greater_withering_whip_desc.text: Disarms enemy target and reduces their Bullet Resist.

upgrade_self_bubble_desc.text:
You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which you float slowly and cannot perform actions. Afterwards you gain Spirit Power, Move Speed, and Spirit Resist.
Can be canceled early.
Activation cancels any active ability.

shifting_veil_bonus.text: Spirit Power, Speed, and Spirit Resist

upgrade_rescue_beam_desc.text: Heals a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of Max Health. Once while healing, you can Pull the target towards you. Can be self-cast.

upgrade_ability_refresher_desc.text: Reset the cooldown of all your abilities and restore all your charges.

upgrade_cold_front_desc.text: Release an expanding ice blast that deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and Slows targets it hits.

upgrade_arctic_blast_desc.text:
Release an expanding ice blast that deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}, Freezing and then Slowing targets it hits.

Slowed targets have their stamina regen frozen

upgrade_target_stun_desc.text:
Apply a Stun after {s:StunDelay}s. Stun duration is increased against airborne targets.

Increases the target's gravity for the duration of the stun.

upgrade_aoe_root_active.text:
Throw a vacuum grenade, pulling all enemies into a small area and applying Slowing Hex.

Alt Cast to Target Unit Directly.

upgrade_glitch_desc.text:
Curses an enemy - interrupting, Silencing, Disarming, and preventing item usage. Removes all non-ultimate buffs.

Your own Damage Output is reduced for the duration.

upgrade_bullet_resist_shredder_desc.text: Reduces Bullet Resist on enemies when you deal {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}.

upgrade_ability_power_shard_active.text:
Reset the cooldown of the imbued non-ultimate ability.

This item's cooldown is increased by the cooldown of the imbued ability.

upgrade_arcane_extension_desc.text: Imbue an ability to increase its Duration.

upgrade_imbued_duration_extender_desc.text: Increases the duration of your abilities and items.

upgrade_diviners_kevlar_desc.text: Upon casting an ultimate ability gain a Barrier and temporary Spirit Power.

upgrade_infuser_desc.text: Gain Spirit Lifesteal and Spirit Power.

upgrade_acolytes_glove_desc.text:
When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, deal extra {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} with the attack and reduce the target's Spirit Resist.

Cooldown is {s:LightMeleeCooldownMult}x longer for Light Melee hits.

upgrade_spirit_snatch_desc.text:
When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, the attack deals extra {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and steals Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.

Effects are reduced by {s:LightMeleeReduction}% for Light Melee hits.

upgrade_magic_storm_desc.text: Imbue an ability with permanent Spirit Power. When that ability is used, gain bonus Move Speed and maintain full speed while attacking.

upgrade_suppressor_desc.text: When you deal {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} to enemies, you also reduce their Fire Rate.

upgrade_quick_silver_desc.text: Your imbued ability charges up over time with {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusSpiritDamage'}, {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusFireRate'}, and reloads bullets on use.

upgrade_resonant_healing_desc.text: Heal and gain bonus Movement Speed for a short duration when you cast an ability.

upgrade_magic_carpet_desc.text:
Summon a Magic Carpet that will fly you away. While flying you are immune to slows and doing any action will dismiss the carpet.
Cannot use abilities while the carpet is being summoned.

upgrade_superacolytes_glove_desc.text: After dealing an accumulated {s:StoredSpiritDamage} spirit damage, your next Heavy Melee Attack deals an additional {s:StoredSpiritDamage} spirit damage.

upgrade_spirit_burn_desc.text:
Dealing significant {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} to an enemy within {s:DamageThresholdDuration}s causes an explosion dealing damage and a burn to that enemy. While burning, enemies take damage over time and receive reduced healing.
The cooldown is per enemy, so each target can only be burned once per cooldown. Deals half-damage on non-heroes.

upgrade_ultimate_burst_desc.text: Damage from your ultimate applies a {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Stun'} and deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusSpiritDamage'} after a short delay.

upgrade_ultimate_burst_hint.text: This effect can only trigger once per target per ultimate.

upgrade_corpse_explosion_desc.text: Kills or assists cause an explosion where the victim dies. Kills against heroes have greater radius and damage.

upgrade_goose_egg_desc.text: Gain souls over time, as long as you are alive.

upgrade_goose_egg_active_desc.text:
Hatch the egg, gaining souls and permanent buffs.

The value of the egg grows the longer you hold onto it.

Gain a permanent buff per {s:BonusBuffsPerGold} Souls accrued when hatched.

upgrade_health_stimpak_desc.text: Grant Regen and Sprint Speed to the target. Gets dispelled if you take damage from enemy players or objectives. Can be self-cast.

upgrade_shrink_ray_desc.text: Reduces Model Size and grants Move Speed to the target. Allows usage of tunnels in this mode. Can be self-cast.

upgrade_guardian_ward_desc.text:
Provide the target with a Barrier and temporary Move Speed.
Can be self-cast.
Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

upgrade_divine_barrier_desc.text:
Remove all non-stun debuffs from the target and provide them with a Barrier and Move Speed.
Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

upgrade_restorative_locket_active_desc.text:
When an enemy uses an ability within {s:Radius}m range from you, store one Restoration Stack.

Consume all stacks to heal yourself and replenish up to {s:MaxStaminaRestore} stamina based on how many stacks you have.

upgrade_cheat_death_unkillable_passive.text:
When you would take lethal damage, instead become temporarily death immune and remove all non-stun debuffs.

While death immune, you deal reduced damage and have reduced healing.

upgrade_healing_booster_desc.text: Increases the effectiveness of your healing.

upgrade_debuff_reducer_desc.text: Reduces the duration of all negative effects applied to you.

upgrade_reduce_debuff_duration_active_de.text:
Purge all non-ultimate negative effects currently applied to you. If any effects were removed, heal yourself and gain a move speed bonus.
Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.

upgrade_rupture_desc.text:
Inflict damage over time to a target, dealing damage based on their current health.
Decay's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.

upgrade_discord_desc.text:
Apply Spirit Resist, Debuff Resist and an aura on a friendly target that deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritIcon'}damage to enemies proportional to their max health. Existing debuffs on the target are reduced.
Can be self cast.

upgrade_chonky_desc.text: After not taking damage for a period, gain health regen.

upgrade_chonky_high_health_passive_desc.text: When you are above {s:HealthThreshold}% health, you have bonus Move Speed.

upgrade_damage_recycler_desc.text: Reduces the effect of enemy applied healing reduction.

upgrade_personal_rejuvenator_desc.text: Respawns the hero at the spot they died.

upgrade_phantom_strike_desc.text: Teleport to an enemy target and pull them to the ground. Dealing damage, Move speed reduction and Disarm.

upgrade_rebirth_passive.text: If you die, after {s:RespawnDelay}s you will respawn at your death location with partial health.

upgrade_return_fire_desc.text: Automatically fire a bullet towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon.

upgrade_regenerating_bullet_shield_desc.text: While you are above {s:LifeThreshold}% health, gain {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'WeaponDamage'} and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusFireRate'}.

upgrade_magic_shield_desc.text: While you are above {s:LifeThreshold}% health, gain bonus {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Spirit'} and Cooldown Reduction.

upgrade_weapon_shielding_desc.text: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'WeaponDamage'} from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

upgrade_spirit_bubble_desc.text: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

upgrade_grit_desc.text: Gain a Barrier for a short duration.

upgrade_unstoppable_desc.text:
Temporarily suppress negative status effects and become immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm.
Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.

upgrade_colossus_desc.text:
Grow larger in size, gaining {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BulletResist'}, {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritResist'}, and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MeleeDamage'}.

Nearby enemies suffer from {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'} and have reduced dash speed.

upgrade_melee_rebuttal_desc.text: On a successful Parry against an enemy Hero, Heal yourself for the damage parried and returns that damage to the target, and temporarily gain increased damage.

upgrade_counterspell_desc.text: Your next parry protects you from the damage and effects of enemy abilities and items. On a successful spell parry {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Heal'} and gain {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MoveSpeed'} and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Spirit'}.

upgrade_tech_purge_desc.text: When below {s:HealthThreshold}% health, gain additional Spirit Resist.

upgrade_improved_bullet_armor_desc.text: When below {s:HealthThreshold}% health, gain additional Bullet Resist.

upgrade_spellbreaker_desc.text: The next instance of high {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} you take is significantly reduced.

upgrade_juggernaut_slow_desc.text: Enemies that shoot you have their Fire Rate slowed.

upgrade_trophy_collector_desc.text: Whenever you score an assist or kill, gain extra sprint, ability range and passive soul generation. This effect stacks and persists through death.

upgrade_upgrade_auto_cleanse_desc.text: The next Stun, Chain, Immobilize, Sleep or Silence is automatically cleansed. When this happens, you gain a barrier and all your ability cooldowns get reduced by {s:CooldownReductionOnProc}%.

upgrade_superior_stamina_passive.text: Allows an additional use of Air Jump or Air Dash before landing.

upgrade_cardio_calibrator_desc.text: Reduces the effect of enemy Move Speed penalties.

upgrade_cloaking_device_active_desc.text: Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed.

upgrade_cloaking_device_active_ambush_de.text: Attacking or using an ability will end your stealth and start an ambush, temporarily granting you bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Melee Damage.

upgrade_rocket_booster_desc.text:
Launch yourself high into the air and grant yourself a Barrier. While in the air, you can use the active again to drop down faster.

Cannot be used for {s:InterruptCooldown}s if attacked by enemy Hero.

upgrade_vex_barrier_desc.text: Gain a Barrier when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced.

upgrade_spellshield_desc.text: Block the next {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} or Debuff, preventing its effects. Only regenerates outside of combat.

upgrade_heal_on_level_desc.text: When you receive a Boon, automatically heal.

upgrade_absorbing_armor_desc.text: Taking heavy hits of {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} from an enemy reduces a random ability cooldown.

upgrade_healbuff_desc.text:
Applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Heal'} to yourself or an ally grants the target {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusFireRate'} and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusMoveSpeed'}.

Does not apply on innate Regen or passive Bullet/Spirit Lifesteals.

upgrade_aprounds_desc.text: Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance.

upgrade_deflecting_armor_desc.text: Gain a chance to either deflect incoming bullets, preventing all {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'WeaponDamage'} or prevent all on-hit effects from bullets.

upgrade_shadow_step_passive_desc.text: Periodically deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} to all nearby enemies.

upgrade_haunting_scream_desc.text: Launch an expanding projectile which Curses enemies for a short duration.

upgrade_apex_combat_desc.text: Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.

upgrade_aerial_supremacy_passive.text: Allows unlimited use of Air Jump or Air Dash before landing.

upgrade_bulletshredimbue_desc.text: Imbue an ability with increased range. Dealing damage with that ability grants you increased weapon damage per unique hero hit. Has reduced effect on non-heroes.

upgrade_rechargingbullets_desc.text: Dealing significant {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'WeaponDamage'} replenishes a charge for each of your charged abilities.

upgrade_icarus_wings_desc.text: When Airborne, You deal more damage and take reduced damage. Allows unlimited Air Dash and Jumping.

upgrade_mystical_piano_desc.text: After a short delay, enemies in the target area will be stunned and have their stamina depleted. After the stun they will be temporarily dazed.

upgrade_nullification_aura_desc.text: Removes any positive buffs and prevents stamina usage and healing effects on enemies.

upgrade_nullification_aura_deathdamage_d.text: Deals heavy spirit damage upon your death.

upgrade_celestial_guidance_desc.text: Applies an extremely powerful cleanse that replenishes your allies globally.

upgrade_eternal_gift_desc.text: Periodically gain a random permanent stat buff.

upgrade_eternal_gift_respawn_desc.text: Reduces your next death's respawn timer.

upgrade_patrons_blessing_desc.text: Provides yourself and allies with a powerful spirit focused aura. Has reduced values on allies.

upgrade_patrons_blessing_proc_desc.text: Dealing significant Damage to an enemy Hero within {s:DamageThresholdDuration}s causes you to heal yourself and nearby allies.

upgrade_eldritch_shot_desc.text:
Your next bullet applies a powerful debuff reducing the enemy's damage output, healing and movement speed. It also deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusSpiritDamage'} based on the targets current Health.

The bullet is larger and penetrates through targets.

upgrade_cloak_of_opportunity_desc.text: Block the next debuff that would apply movement lock, Stun, Chained, Immobilize, or Sleep and become Unstoppable. Also gain a Barrier and bonus {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MoveSpeed'}

upgrade_runed_gauntlets_desc.text: Everytime you land a heavy melee, your existing cooldowns get reduced.

upgrade_electric_slippers_desc.text:
When sliding, evade bullets, gain fire rate and deal damage to enemies around you.

Cooldown is per target.

upgrade_prism_blast_desc.text: You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which lasers blast out and rotate around you.

upgrade_unstable_concoction_desc.text: Consume a concoction that grants you Unstoppable and increased speed, health, spirit and weapon damage. After a short duration you die and explode, stunning nearby enemies and dealing damage based on your maximum health. Dying this way reduces your respawn time by {s:RespawnTimeMod}%.

upgrade_shivas_bracelet_desc.text:
Imbued ability has its Cooldown reduced and gains Spirit Power. When the ability deals damage, freeze the target and apply bonus damage.

Cooldown is per target.

upgrade_shadow_strike_desc.text: Go Invisible on Stamina use with no detection range. Doing a melee attack while invisible will cause you to steal bullet and spirit resistance from them and deal damage over time.

upgrade_omnicharge_pendant_desc.text: Imbue any active non-ultimate ability with Bonus Ability Charges. Already charged abilities receive more bonus charges.

cosmetic_item_snowball_desc.text:
Throw snowballs at your friends and enemies. Distance and other properties improve as you make progress in the 2025 Holiday Challenge.

Throwing a Snowball at an ally won't inflict damage and will reset its cooldown.

citadel_ability_bull_charge_quip.text: Charge into the fray, dragging enemies along

citadel_ability_bull_charge_desc.text:
Charge forward, {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Pulling'} enemies you hit. Pushing a hero into a wall applies {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Stun'}.
If you collide with a hero you move faster during your charge.

citadel_ability_bull_charge_t3_desc.text:
{s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown
On Hero Collide: +{s:WeaponDamageBonus} Weapon Damage for {s:WeaponPowerIncreaseDuration}s

citadel_ability_bull_heal_desc.text: Drain health from nearby enemies, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDPS'} and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Healing'} for a portion of the damage dealt.

citadel_ability_bull_heal_t3_desc.text: +{s:Radius}m Radius and +{s:DPS} DPS with improved Spirit scaling

citadel_ability_passive_beefy_quip.text: Regenerate some of the damage you receive

citadel_ability_passive_beefy_desc.text: Gain bonus defensive attributes. Taking damage grants temporary {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Regen'} for a portion of the damage taken.

citadel_ability_bull_leap_quip.text: Smash into enemies from above, stunning them

citadel_ability_bull_leap_desc.text: Leap high into the air before crashing into the ground, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Stun'}.

citadel_ability_bull_leap_t3_desc.text: On cast, become Unstoppable for {s:ImmunityDuration}s and +{s:ImpactRadius}m Impact Radius

citadel_ability_static_charge_desc.text: Apply a charge to a target enemy hero. After a short duration, the static charge stuns and damages enemies within the radius.

citadel_ability_static_charge_quip.text: Apply a delayed area stun to an enemy hero

citadel_ability_static_charge_v2_desc.text: Strike in front of you with lightning, applying a charge to the unit or area hit. After a short duration, the static charge stuns and damages enemies within the radius.

citadel_ability_lightning_ball_quip.text: Launch a damaging ball of lightning

citadel_ability_lightning_ball_desc.text: Shoot a ball of lightning that travels in a straight line. Does damage to all targets in its radius. Slows down when damaging enemies and stops if it hits the world.

citadel_ability_lightning_ball_t2_desc.text: -{s:SlowPercent}% move speed on hit targets and +{s:MaxLifetime}s Lifetime

ability_power_surge_quip.text: Create electric arcs with your shots

ability_power_surge_desc.text: Power up your weapon with a shock effect, making your bullets proc shock damage on your target. This shock damage bounces to enemies near your target. Occurs once per burst shot.

ability_power_surge_t2_desc.text:
+{s:BonusMoveSpeed}m Move Speed
+{s:BonusPerChain} Damage and increased scaling

citadel_ability_storm_cloud_quip.text: Fry all enemies in a large area

citadel_ability_storm_cloud_desc.text: Channel an expanding storm cloud around you that damages all enemies within its radius. Enemies do not take damage when they are out of line-of-sight.

citadel_ability_storm_cloud_t1_desc.text: +{s:BulletResistOnActive}% Bullet Resist while channeling Storm Cloud

citadel_ability_storm_cloud_t2_desc.text:
+{s:AbilityChannelTime}s Channel Time
+{s:Radius}m Final Radius
+{s:InitialRadius}m Initial Radius

citadel_ability_storm_cloud_lightning_st.text: While channeling, press{g:citadel_binding:'Attack'}to mark the targeted area to be struck with a powerful lightning bolt that knocks enemies away after a {s:LightningStrikeDelay}s delay. One use per cast.

ability_cadence_tempo_bullet_desc.text: Casting an ability empowers your next {s:MaxProcCount} bullets. Empowered bullets deal bonus Damage and reduce all your Cooldowns .

ability_cadence_charm_desc.text:
Glance in a target direction, dealing Damage to the first enemy hit and marking them.

If the victim was already marked, they instead take additional Damage and become Charmed.

Charmed enemies are forced to run towards you, but at reduced speeds.

citadel_ability_fissure_wall_quip.text: Conjure a wall to block your foes

citadel_ability_fissure_wall_desc.text:
Cast a wall that applies slow on enemies it passes through. Erupt the wall to divide the terrain in half and damage nearby enemies.
After casting, press{g:citadel_binding:'Attack'}or{g:citadel_binding:'Ability3'}to erupt the wall early.

Can be Destroyed with Melee Attacks

citadel_ability_fissure_wall_t1_desc.text: Amplifies {s:hero_name}'s damage by +{s:BonusDamagePercent}% on hit enemies for {s:DebuffDuration}s

citadel_ability_fissure_wall_t3_desc.text:
Deploy {s:CreateTurrets} Mini Turrets near the wall for {s:TurretLifeTime}s
+{s:SlowPercent}% Slow

citadel_ability_mobile_resupply_desc.text: Deploy a spirit that provides {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Healing'} to nearby allies.

citadel_ability_mobile_resupply_t3_desc.text:
+{s:MaxHealthRegenPct}% Max HP Regen
+{s:HealRadius}m Heal Radius
+{s:SpiritResist}% Spirit Resist

citadel_ability_shieldedsentry_desc.text:
Deploy a turret that shoots enemies, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDPS'}. The turret expires after a limited lifetime.
Turrets deal reduced damage to troopers and objectives.

citadel_ability_shieldedsentry_t1_desc.text: +{s:TurretDPS} Turret DPS and +{s:TurretAttackRange}m Attack Range

citadel_ability_shieldedsentry_t3_desc.text: +{s:AttackSpeedMult}% Turret Fire Rate and +{s:TurretLifetime}s Turret Lifetime

citadel_ability_rocket_barrage_desc.text:
Unleashes a volley of rockets that home in on a targeted location.

{s:hero_name} is slowed and is still able to use stamina.

citadel_ability_rocket_barrage_t1_desc.text: Applies {s:MoveSlowPercent}% movement and dash slow for {s:SlowDuration}s

citadel_ability_rocket_barrage_t3_desc.text: +{s:ExplosionRadius}m Radius and +{s:DamagePerRocket} Damage per Rocket with increased spirit scaling

citadel_ability_psychic_lift_quip.text: Lift an enemy, interrupting and silencing them

citadel_ability_psychic_lift_desc.text: Lift an enemy hero into the air and then slam them towards the target location.

citadel_ability_psychic_lift_t3_desc.text: +{s:AbilityDuration}s Debuff Duration and +{s:AbilityCastRange}m Throw and Cast Range

citadel_ability_psychic_lift_slam_desc.text: Slamming the target into the ground deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}, applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'} and prevents Stamina and movement-based items and abilities

citadel_ability_projectmind_t2_desc.text: {s:CombatBarrier} Barrier for {s:BarrierDuration}s. Barrier scales with Spirit Power.

citadel_ability_wraith_rapidfire_desc.text: Temporarily boosts your fire rate and deal bonus {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}

citadel_ability_wraith_rapidfire_t2_desc.text: +{s:BonusFireRate}% Fire Rate and +{s:AbilityDuration}s Duration

citadel_ability_wraith_rapidfire_t3_desc.text: Unlimited Ammo and Increased Scaling on Spirit Damage Per Bullet

citadel_ability_card_toss_desc.text:
Deal weapon damage to summon cards of a random suit. Each card can be thrown, dealing damage and applying a different effect depending of its suit. Cards thrown fly towards the enemy or point under your crosshair.

Alt-cast to throw first card

citadel_ability_card_toss_t3_desc.text: All suits are improved and higher chance for Jokers

ability_header_card_toss_suits_desc.text: Each suit provides a different bonus. Jokers counts as all suits

citadel_ability_chrono_time_wall_quip.text: Create a wall that greatly slows projectiles

citadel_ability_chrono_time_wall_desc.text:
Create a time warping wall that stops time for all enemy projectiles and bullets that touch it and increases the speed and damage of friendly bullets.

Enemies that touch the wall will be briefly slowed and silenced .

citadel_ability_chrono_pulse_grenade_qui.text: Throw a grenade that pulses, dealing damage and time slowing

citadel_ability_chrono_pulse_grenade_des.text: Throw a grenade that begins pulsing when it lands. Each pulse expands the radius and applies {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}, time slow, and stacking {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'DamageAmp'} for {s:hero_name} against the victim.

citadel_ability_chrono_pulse_grenade_t2_.text: +{s:PulseDamage} Pulse Damage and increased Spirit scaling

citadel_ability_chrono_swap_quip.text: Swap positions with an enemy hero.

citadel_ability_chrono_swap_desc.text: Fire a projectile that <span class="highlight">swaps your position with the target enemy hero.

citadel_ability_chrono_swap_t1_desc.text: {s:CombatBarrier} Barrier for {s:BarrierDuration}s. Barrier scales with Spirit

citadel_ability_chrono_swap_t3_desc.text: Swaps all enemies within {s:MultiSwap}m of hit target and +{s:MaxHealthDamage}% Max Health Damage

citadel_ability_chrono_kinetic_carbine_q.text: Charge up your weapon to deal high damage and timestop

citadel_ability_chrono_kinetic_carbine_d.text:
Charge up a powerful shot of time energy, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and applying a Time-Stop to enemies hit. The damage dealt increases with {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'WeaponDamage'}. Move speed is increased while charging.

While in the air and charging, {g:citadel_binding:'ADS'} to timeslow your movement.

citadel_ability_chrono_kinetic_carbine_t.text: +{s:SpeedBoostDuration}s Charge Hold Duration and +{s:MaxBonusBulletDamage_scale}% Damage Scaling

ability_incendiary_projectile_quip.text: Spew napalm that amplifies your damage

ability_incendiary_projectile_desc.text: Spew an incendiary mixture, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}, applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'}, and coating targets in napalm.

ability_incendiary_projectile_t3_desc.text: Napalm Effect: +{s:IncomingDamagePercentFromCaster}% Damage Taken and {s:HealAmpReceivePenaltyPercent}% Healing

ability_flame_dash_quip.text: Blaze forward, leaving a flame trail in your wake

ability_flame_dash_desc.text:
Dash forward, gaining {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SlowResistance'} while leaving a flaming trail that deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDPS'}.

Hold{g:citadel_binding:'MoveForward'}while active to dash farther.

ability_flame_dash_t3_desc.text: Enable {s:AbilityCharges} Ability Charges with {s:AbilityCooldownBetweenCharge}s Recharge time

ability_afterburn_quip.text: Shoot enemies to set them on fire

ability_afterburn_desc.text:
Weapon hits build up a burning effect, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDPS'}.

Abilities refresh to the base burn duration and weapon hits extend it.

ability_fire_bomb_quip.text: Stun all nearby enemies after a short delay

ability_fire_bomb_desc.text:
Become a living bomb, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Stun'} to all nearby enemies after a delay.

Once cast, Concussive Combustion cannot be interrupted.

ability_sleep_dagger_desc.text: Throw a dagger that damages and sleeps the target. Sleeping targets wake up shortly after being damaged. Throwing a Dagger does not break your invisibility. Sleep Dagger does not interrupt enemies' channeling abilities.

ability_sleep_dagger_t1_desc.text: {s:BulletResistReduction}% Bullet Resist Reduction for {s:BulletResistReductionDuration}s on wake-up

ability_sleep_dagger_t3_desc.text:
{s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown
-{s:SlowPercent}% Move and Dash Speed for {s:DebuffDuration}s on wake-up

ability_stacking_damage_quip.text: Deal increasing bullet damage to a target

ability_stacking_damage_desc.text: Shooting a target increases your bullet damage on that target. Gain one stack per bullet hit, two if the hit is a headshot.

ability_stacking_damage_t1_desc.text: {s:ProcDamage} Spirit damage and {s:SlowPercent}% slow for {s:SlowDuration}s to target every {s:ProcDamageStackCount} stacks

ability_smoke_bomb_desc.text: Fade out of sight, becoming invisible and gaining sprint speed. Attacking removes invisibility, but using items does not. Close enemies can see through your invisibility.

ability_smoke_bomb_t3_desc.text:
Dispels non-ult debuffs
Grants +{s:BulletLifesteal}% Bullet Lifesteal for {s:BuffDuration}s

ability_bullet_flurry_quip.text: Unleash a flurry of bullets around you

ability_bullet_flurry_desc.text: Enter a flurry, firing your weapon at nearby enemies with perfect accuracy and added Bullet Damage.

citadel_ability_stomp_quip.text: Release a ground pulse that knocks enemies into the air

citadel_ability_stomp_desc.text: Release an energy pulse that travels along the ground, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'KnockUp'}.

citadel_ability_stomp_t2_desc.text: On Hit: {s:BulletResistReduction}% Bullet Resist and -{s:SlowPercent}% Move Speed for {s:SlowDuration}s

citadel_ability_stomp_t3_desc.text: +{s:Damage} Damage and +{s:StompRange}m Cast Range

citadel_ability_void_sphere_quip.text: Blink in and out of existence

citadel_ability_void_sphere_desc.text:
Briefly become untargetable while teleporting to the target location. Restores stamina upon use.

{g:citadel_binding:'AltCast'}: Bring nearby allies with you.

citadel_ability_self_vacuum_quip.text: Pull in and stun the enemy team

citadel_ability_self_vacuum_desc.text: Create a singularity in your hands, dealing <{g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDPS'}, applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Stun'}, and pulling in nearby enemies.

citadel_ability_nikuman_quip.text: Heal yourself and those around you

citadel_ability_nikuman_desc.text:
While channeling, restore health over time to you and any allies nearby.
You can dash and melee without breaking the channel.

citadel_ability_nikuman_t1_desc.text: Aura provides +{s:MovementSpeedBonus}m Move Speed during channel

citadel_ability_nikuman_t3_desc.text: Full move and ability use and additionally heals +{s:HealMaxHealthPercent}% of Max Health per second

ability_warden_lock_down_quip.text: Curse your target, rooting them if they don't escape

ability_warden_lock_down_desc.text: Curse an enemy hero. If they don't move away from their initial position within the escape time, they will be damaged and immobilized.

ability_warden_lock_down_t1_desc.text: {s:hero_name} deals +{s:BulletArmorReduction}% more Bullet Damage to trapped Heroes for {s:BulletArmorReductionDuration}s

ability_warden_lock_down_t3_desc.text:
{s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown
Silences enemies until they escape or are immobilized

ability_warden_high_alert_quip.text: Gain a Barrier and move speed

ability_warden_high_alert_desc.text: Gain a Barrier and bonus move speed.

ability_warden_high_alert_t3_desc.text: +{s:StatusResistancePercent}% Debuff Resistance and improved Barrier scaling

ability_warden_crowd_control_desc.text: Throw a flask that damages and reduces the weapon damage and move speed of enemies it hits.

ability_warden_crowd_control_t2_desc.text: +{s:Damage} Damage and {s:WeaponPowerDebuff}% Weapon Damage

ability_warden_crowd_control_t3_desc.text:
{s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown and +{s:Radius}m Radius
Applies -{s:FireRateSlow}% Fire Rate

ability_warden_riot_protocol_quip.text: Emit pulses that steal health from enemies

ability_warden_riot_protocol_desc.text:
After charging for {s:AbilityCastDelay}s, release pulses that damage enemies and heal you based on the damage done.
While channeling Last Stand you have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist.

ability_wrecking_ball_quip.text: Throw a ball of scrap that stuns enemies

ability_wrecking_ball_desc.text: Create a large ball of scrap that can be thrown, damaging and stunning the first enemy hit. The ball takes time to create and you move slower while carrying it.

ability_wrecker_salvage_desc.text: Latches onto an Enemy, damaging them and healing yourself while attached. Targets must be in line of sight and within max range to stay latched. A successful kill also restores a Bio Blast charge.

ability_wrecker_salvage_quip.text: Consume an enemy trooper or neutral

ability_scrap_blast_desc.text: Shoots out a blast of consumed remains, damaging and slowing enemies. Multiple hits increase the slow.

ability_scrap_blast_quip.text: Shoot a blast of bio mass

ability_wrecker_ultimate_desc.text: Grabs any enemy looked at by Wrecker, putting them in stasis and holding them overhead. Stuns, and damages all captured enemies when finished. Any grabbed NPCs are salvaged.

ability_wrecker_teleport_desc.text: Launch a flying shadow copy of yourself that you control, teleporting your original body to wherever it lands. The teleport explosion slows enemies and deals damage based on how long you were flying.

ability_wrecker_teleport_quip.text: Launch a flying illusion of yourself, teleporting your real body where the illusion lands

citadel_ability_wrecker_garbage_suck_des.text: Create an area that slows nearby enemies and damages them after a channel. Damage scales with total channel time.

citadel_ability_wrecker_bouldergrenade_d.text: Create a large ball of scrap, damaging and stunning the first enemy hit. Nearby enemies take reduced damage.

citadel_ability_lash_quip.text: Use your whip to pull yourself to an enemy

citadel_ability_lash_desc.text: Pull yourself through the air toward a target. Using Grapple also resets your limit of air jumps and dashes.

citadel_ability_lash_t2_desc.text: +{s:AbilityCastRange}m Cast Range and gain +{s:WeaponDamageBonus} Weapon Damage for {s:WeaponDamageBonusDuration}s

citadel_ability_lash_down_strike_quip.text: Slam down to the ground, damaging enemies

citadel_ability_lash_down_strike_desc.text: Stomp the ground beneath you, damaging enemies in front of you. If you perform Ground Strike while airborne, you quickly dive towards the ground. Damage grows slower after 25m.

citadel_ability_lash_down_strike_t2_desc.text: Struck enemies are knocked up and slowed by {s:EnemySlowPct}% for {s:SlowDuration}s

citadel_ability_lash_down_strike_t3_desc.text: Damage Per Meter +110% and improved scaling

ability_lash_flog_quip.text: Heals from targets ahead of you

ability_lash_flog_desc.text: Strike enemies in front of you with your whip, {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Healing'} for a portion of the damage dealt.

citadel_ability_lash_ultimate_quip.text: Lift enemies and smash them into the ground

citadel_ability_lash_ultimate_desc.text:
Focus on enemies to connect whips to them. After channeling, connected enemies are lifted and stunned then slammed into the ground. Your victims and any enemies in the landing zone will be damaged and slowed.
Press{g:citadel_binding:'Attack'}to throw connected enemies early. Enemies that are not in line of sight or go out of range during the latch time will not be grabbed.

citadel_ability_lash_ultimate_t3_desc.text:
Stun enemies in Radius for {s:StunDuration}s
+{s:AbilityCastRange}m Cast Range

ability_ice_grenade_desc.text: Throw a grenade that explodes in a cloud of freezing ice that {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Heals'} allies and applies {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and move speed reduction to enemies.

ability_ice_grenade_t1_desc.text: +{s:Damage} Damage and +{s:HealAmount} Heal Amount

ability_ice_grenade_t2_desc.text: {s:AbilityCooldown} Cooldown and debuff now freezes Stamina Regen

ability_ice_grenade_t3_desc.text: +{s:Radius}m Radius. Damage and Heal Spirit Scaling increased.

ability_icebeam_desc.text: Shoot freezing cold energy out in front of you, damaging targets and progressively reducing their movement and fire rate the longer you sustain the beam on them. You have reduced move speed while using Arctic Beam. The beam may also claim Souls.

ability_icebeam_t1_desc.text: -{s:MaxSlowPercent}% to Fire Rate and Move Speed

ability_icebeam_t2_desc.text: +{s:DPS} DPS and increased Spirit Scaling

ability_icebeam_t3_desc.text: {s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown and Fires {s:BeamSplitCount} additional Arctic Beams within {s:BeamSplit}m of the last target hit.

ability_icepath_quip.text: Speed around on a floating path of ice

ability_icepath_desc.text:
{s:hero_name} creates a floating trail of ice and snow that gives movement bonuses to him and his allies. Kelvin gains {s:SlowResistancePercent}% slow resistance for the duration. Enemies can also walk on the floating trail.
Press {g:citadel_binding:'Roll'} / {g:citadel_binding:'Crouch'} to travel up or down while in Ice Path.

ability_icepath_t1_desc.text: +{s:MoveSpeedBonus}m Move Speed and +{s:BulletResist}% Bullet Resist for {s:hero_name} while on Ice Path

ability_icepath_t3_desc.text: +{s:BonusSpiritPct}% Spirit and +{s:BonusSpirit} Spirit for {s:hero_name} while on Ice Path

ability_ice_dome_desc.text:
Target yourself or a Hero to freeze the air and create an impenetrable dome around them. While in the dome, allies gain rapid {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Regen'} and enemies are slowed.

Objectives becomes Invulnerable and Frozen under Frozen Shelter

ability_ice_dome_t3_desc.text:
Purges non-ult debuffs for you and your allies.
+{s:BonusHealthRegen} Health Regen that now scales with Spirit

citadel_ability_uppercut_desc.text:
Deal {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MeleeDamage'} to nearby enemies and apply {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'KnockBack'}.

When they land, they deal {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and apply {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'ReducedFireRate'} to other nearby enemies.

Exploding Uppercut can be used on allies.

citadel_ability_uppercut_t2_desc.text: On Hero Hit: Gain fast spin-up time, 2x weapon range and +{s:BuffBaseWeaponPct}% weapon damage for {s:BuffDuration}s

citadel_ability_uppercut_t3_desc.text: On Hero Hit: Set Grapple Arm cooldown to 0 and restores +{s:MissingHPHeal}% of your missing health

citadel_ability_sticky_bomb_quip.text: Plant a bomb on an enemy

citadel_ability_sticky_bomb_desc.text:
Attach a bomb that explodes after a delay, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} to nearby enemies.

If the bomb hits or kills a hero, you gain permanent bonus damage on Sticky Bomb.

Stacks diminish by half after {s:OnHitDiminish} hits and {s:OnKillDiminish} kills

citadel_ability_sticky_bomb_t3_desc.text: On Cast: +{s:MovementSpeedBonus}m Move Speed and +{s:StatusResistancePercent}% Debuff Resistance for {s:MovementSpeedBonusDuration}s

citadel_ability_bebop_laser_beam_desc.text: Channel a powerful torrent of energy that deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and applies {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'}.

citadel_ability_bebop_laser_beam_t3_desc.text: Hyper Beam heals {s:hero_name} for {s:BeamLifesteal}% of its damage on Heroes. {s:BeamLifestealNonHeroPercent}% on non-hero

citadel_ability_hook_quip.text: Pull in a target to you

citadel_ability_hook_desc.text:
Launch out a mechanical hand that {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Pulls'} the first character it hits, reeling them in.

Grapple Arm can be used on allies.

citadel_ability_hook_t1_desc.text: +{s:BulletAmp}% weapon damage against victims for {s:BuffDuration}s

ability_bebop_stickybomb2_quip.text: Throw a sticky bomb on an enemy

ability_bebop_stickybomb2_desc.text:
Throw a Sticky Bomb that explodes after a delay, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} to nearby enemies.

If the bomb hits a hero, it attaches to them and deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusSpiritDamage'}.

ability_explosive_barrel_quip.text: Throw a barrel that explodes when shot

ability_explosive_barrel_desc.text:
Throw a barrel that explodes after a delay, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}, setting enemies on fire and applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'KnockUp'}.

The barrel can be detonated early by being shot, melee'd, or detonated by another barrel.

The burn stacks, so overlapping barrels burn for their combined damage.
Can be Alt-Cast to place the barrel infront of {s:hero_name}.

ability_explosive_barrel_t3_desc.text:
+{s:ImpactDamage} Impact Damage
+{s:DPS} Burn Damage per Second
{s:AbilityCooldownBetweenCharge} Charge Time
Improved Spirit Scaling

ability_hat_trick_quip.text: Throws her hat strike and reveal enemies

ability_hat_trick_desc.text: Throws out her hat to strike enemies, slowing and revealing them through walls.

ability_bounce_pad_desc.text:
Drop a bounce pad in the world that launches any hero.

You explode on landing, dealing Damage to any nearby enemies.

The explosion can only occur once per person per Bounce Pad.

ability_bounce_pad_t2_desc.text: You and allies gain a +{s:SpeedOnLand}m/s move speed bonus for {s:BuffDuration}s on landing

ability_crackshot_desc.text:
Headshots deal bonus Damage and applies a Fading Move Speed penalty. This effect can only occur when off cooldown.

Cooldown is reduced by {s:CrackshotNPCCDReduction}% on NPC hits.
Crackshot ignores range damage fall-off and does not apply to objectives.

ability_crackshot_t3_desc.text: {s:AbilityCooldownPerHeadshot}s Cooldown on Hero Headshots. {s:AbilityCooldownPerHeadshotNPC}s on NPC Headshots

ability_gravity_lasso_quip.text: Grab an enemy and drag them behind you

ability_gravity_lasso_desc.text:
Throw out your lasso, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}, {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Pulling'}, and applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Stun'}.
Using a Bounce Pad extends the duration of Spirit Lasso.

ability_perched_predator_desc.text:
Send a Spirit Cat forward that grab's targets in its way. Grabbing a Hero will cause an explosion soon after.
Press {g:citadel_binding:'Ability1'} to manually create the explosion.

ability_perched_predator_quip.text: Send out a Spirit Cat to grab enemies

ability_nano_pounce_desc.text:
Leap at a target to inflict Light Melee damage and slow on nearby enemies.
You may use Pounce on a second target if used within {s:DoublePounceTime}s

ability_nano_pounce_t2_desc.text: Reloads up to {s:ActiveReloadPercent}% of your ammo and applies +{s:FireRateSlow}% Fire Rate Slow.

ability_nano_proximity_ritual_quip.text: Deploy a statue that survey's an area

ability_nano_proximity_ritual_desc.text: Deploy a Statue to track enemies in an area. The Ward will also attack enemies recently damaged by {s:hero_name}. Targeted enemies have reduced healing and heal {s:hero_name} when damaged.

ability_nano_proximity_ritual_t1_desc.text: Statues gain Invisibility when not attacking.

ability_nano_proximity_ritual_t3_desc.text: {s:StatueVictimDamageReduction}% Damage Reduction and {s:HealAmpReceivePenaltyPercent}% Heal Reduction on targets.

ability_nano_shadow_step_desc.text: Mark your enemies and bathe yourself in shadow to strengthen your attacks and make yourself Invisible. Attacking will only temporarily reveal you. Hitting enemies with Melee damage will reduce their bullet resist (stacking)

ability_nano_shadow_step_quip.text: Enter the shadows to gain the advantage on your enemies

ability_nano_shadow_step_t3_desc.text: Heavy Melee attacks cause Silence for {s:SilenceOnHeavyDuration}s

ability_nano_clustergrenade_desc.text:
Throw a cluster of bombs that detonate after a delay, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}.

Enemies hit by multiple bombs take {s:MultiHitPenaltyPercentage}% damage.

ability_nano_clustergrenade_t2_desc.text: Per Bomb Touch : {s:MeleeResistReduction}% Melee Resist for {s:MeleeResistReductionDuration}s

ability_nano_catform_desc.text:
Turn to shadows and possess Ava. You gain {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusMoveSpeed'} that increases over time, and become hidden on the minimap.

Taking damage from an enemy hero resets your bonus move speed and puts Ava on a brief cooldown.

ability_nano_catform_t2_desc.text: +{s:HealthRegen} Health Regen & +{s:MaxBonusMoveSpeedPercent}% Max Move Speed

ability_nano_catform_t3_desc.text: Gain Damage Amp over time, up to {s:OutgoingDamagePercent}%. Lingers for {s:DamageAmpDuration}s

ability_nano_dash_desc.text:
Dash forward before slashing all enemies in a circle, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MeleeDamage'}.

If the ability hits at least one hero, {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Heal'} a small amount of health.

ability_nano_dash_t3_desc.text: +{s:ImpactDamage} Damage & On Hero Hit: {s:CooldownRefundPercent}% Cooldown Refund

ability_nano_shadow_pulse_desc.text:
Instantly turn to shadows, becoming untargetable, gaining {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusMoveSpeed'}, and dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}.

After a delay, return from the shadows, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} again.

ability_nano_shadow_pulse_t3_desc.text: On Completion: Heal for {s:HealAmount} and refund all ability cooldowns

ability_nano_shadow_pulse_quip.text: Turn to Shadows, gaining movespeed and dealing delayed damage

ability_charged_shot_quip.text: Charge up a long range shot

ability_charged_shot_desc.text: Charge up a powerful shot that pierces through enemies. Hold {g:citadel_binding:'Ability1'} or {g:citadel_binding:'Attack'} to hold the shot.

ability_charged_shot_t3_desc.text: Improved damage scaling and {s:AbilityCooldownBetweenCharge}s Charge Delay

ability_power_jump_quip.text: Jump high up in the air and unleash multishots

ability_power_jump_desc.text:
Launches you high in the air, allowing you to glide slowly. While airborne, you gain Weapon Damage and multishot on your weapon.
{g:citadel_binding:'AltCast'}for reduced jump height.
Press{g:citadel_binding:'Mantle'}to cancel the glide.

ability_power_jump_t1_desc.text: While airborne, +{s:WeaponDamageBonus} Weapon Damage and weapon damage applies {s:SlowPercent}% movement slow for {s:SlowDuration}s

ability_power_jump_t3_desc.text: While airborne, +{s:BulletLifestealPercent}% Bullet Lifesteal, +{s:TechLifestealPercent}% Spirit Lifesteal and +{s:EvasionPercent}% Bullet Evasion

ability_immobilize_trap_quip.text: Place a trap that restricts enemy movement

ability_immobilize_trap_desc.text:
Throw out a trap that begins to arm itself. Once armed, the trap will trigger when an enemy enters its radius, applying Curse and Movement Slow that interrupts, Silences, Disarms, and prevents item usage.
Hit the trap with a Charged Shot to detonate early with increased radius.

ability_guided_arrow_quip.text: Fly your owl to damage enemies from afar

ability_guided_arrow_desc.text:
After {s:AbilityCastDelay}s cast time, launch a spirit owl that you control and which explodes on impact, damaging and stunning enemies. Hold{g:citadel_binding:'MoveForward'}to accelerate the owl.
Press{g:citadel_binding:'Mantle'}to release control. Gain permanent Spirit Power for each enemy hero killed with Guided Owl.

ability_guided_arrow_t3_desc.text: After hit, kills enemies that are below {s:LowHealthEnemyThresholdPct}% Health

ability_blood_bomb_quip.text: Sacrifice some health to launch a damaging bomb

ability_blood_bomb_desc.text:
Sacrifice some of your health to launch a bomb that deals damage after a brief arm time.
Self damage type is Spirit and can be mitigated.

ability_blood_bomb_t3_desc.text: Bombs leave a toxic mess on the ground, dealing {s:BloodSpillDPSPercent}% of the original damage per second, for {s:BloodSpillDuration}s.

ability_life_drain_quip.text: Steal health from an enemy over time

ability_life_drain_desc.text:
Create a tether that drains enemy health over time and heals you. Target must be in line of sight and within max range to drain. You can shoot and use other abilities during the drain, but your move speed is reduced.
{g:citadel_binding:'AltCast'} to give health to friendly Heroes.

ability_life_drain_t3_desc.text: Enables and Grants +2 Charges. Increases spirit scaling.

ability_health_swap_quip.text: Swap your current health with an enemy hero's

ability_health_swap_desc.text: Swaps health levels with an enemy target. There is a minimum health percentage that enemies can be brought down to and a minimum amount of health received based on victims current health.

ability_health_swap_t3_desc.text: On cast, +{s:BonusSpirit} Spirit Power, +{s:BonusFireRate}% Fire Rate and +{s:TechResist}% Spirit Resistance for {s:HealthSwapBuffDuration}s.

ability_blood_shards_quip.text: Stack damage amplification on an enemy

ability_blood_shards_desc.text: Sacrifice some of your health to launch blood shards that apply a stack of Malice. Each stack slows the victim and increases the damage they take from you. The slow effect decreases over time.

citadel_ability_hornet_chain_quip.text: Tether your enemies to the ground

citadel_ability_hornet_chain_desc.text: Throw a stake that tethers enemies to the location where the stake lands. Enemy movement is restricted to the length of the tether.

citadel_ability_hornet_leap_quip.text: Take flight and empower your weapon

citadel_ability_hornet_leap_desc.text: Leap into the air and fly. While in flight your weapon deals bonus spirit damage and your items have increased range.

citadel_ability_hornet_leap_t3_desc.text:
Hero Kills Refresh Duration.
+{s:MagicDamagePerBullet} Spirit Damage with increased Spirit scaling

citadel_ability_hornet_sting_quip.text: Make a target bleed over time

citadel_ability_hornet_sting_desc.text: Your crow familiar deals impact damage, reduces their bullet resist and applies a bleed that deals damage based on the target's current health.

citadel_ability_hornet_snipe_quip.text: Snipe injured targets for massive damage

citadel_ability_hornet_snipe_desc.text: Use your scoped rifle to fire a powerful shot over long distances. Deal only partial damage until fully charged after {s:TimeToFullCharge}s of being scoped. Does bonus damage to enemies with less than {s:LowHealthEnemyThresholdPct}% health remaining. Landing a killing blow on a player with Assassinate grants you bonus weapon damage.

ability_burrow_quip.text: Travel underground, emerging with spin damage

ability_burrow_desc.text:
Burrow underground, moving faster, and gaining spirit and bullet armor. Damage from enemy heroes will reduce the speed bonus.

When you jump out, deal {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}, {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'}, and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'KnockUp'}.

ability_burrow2_desc.text: Burrow underground, gaining Movement Speed and Armor. Jumping out deals Damage and knocks enemies into the air.

ability_intimidate_quip.text: Damage enemies nearby, healing from each hit

ability_intimidate_desc.text: Deal damage to nearby enemies and heal yourself based on the damage done. Heal is stronger against enemy heroes.

ability_intimidate_t3_desc.text: Adds a debuff to enemies that lets {s:hero_name} deal +{s:DamageBonus}% Damage to them. Stacks and lasts {s:DebuffDuration}s.

ability_throw_sand_quip.text: Disarm enemies in front of you

ability_throw_sand_desc.text: Spray sand that disarms enemies in front of you and deals damage.

ability_throw_sand_t2_desc.text: Slow targets by -{s:SlowPercent}% and reduces dash distances by {s:GroundDashReductionPercent}%

ability_ult_combo_quip.text: Hold the enemy hero in place and pummel them

ability_ult_combo_desc.text: Hold the target in place, stunning them and dealing damage during the channel. If they die during, or within 3 seconds of Combo ending, you permanently gain max health.

ability_ult_combo_t2_desc.text: {s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown and +{s:ComboBulletResist}% Bullet Resist

ability_ult_combo_t3_desc.text: +{s:AbilityChannelTime}s Duration and +{s:DPS} Damage Per Second and increased scaling

ability_digger_mudshield_desc.text: Gain Bullet Shield, and reduce incoming bullet damage. After {s:ShieldDuration}s or if the ability is reactivated, the shield explodes, dealing damage based on the remaining shield.

citadel_ability_shiv_dagger_quip.text: Apply stacking bleed to the target

citadel_ability_shiv_dagger_desc.text: Throw a knife that bleeds an enemy. Each additional hit adds a stack and refreshes the bleed duration, causing the bleed to increase per stack.

citadel_ability_shiv_dagger_max_rage_des.text: Ultimate Unlock: While rage is full knives will ricochet to another enemy and apply a slow to enemies they bleed.

citadel_ability_shiv_dagger_t3_desc.text: +{s:BleedDPSPerStack} Bleed DPS with increased Spirit scaling

citadel_ability_shiv_dash_quip.text: Dash ahead, damaging all enemies along the path

citadel_ability_shiv_dash_desc.text: Perform a dash forward, damaging enemies along the path. Hit Enemies have their {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritResist'} reduced. This debuff can stack.

citadel_ability_shiv_dash_ult_desc.text: Ultimate Unlock: While rage is full an echo of Shiv retraces the dash path after a short delay, damaging enemies again.

citadel_ability_shiv_dash_t3_desc.text:
+{s:ImpactDamage} Impact Damage
-{s:CooldownReductionOnHit}s Cooldown per Hero hit.

citadel_ability_shiv_defer_damage_quip.text: Defer a portion of damage taken

citadel_ability_shiv_defer_damage_desc.text: Take only a portion of incoming damage immediately and defer the rest to be taken over time. Activate to clear a portion of the deferred damage.

citadel_ability_shiv_defer_damage_max_ra.text: Ultimate Unlock: While rage is full the amount of damage deferred is increased.

citadel_ability_shiv_killing_blow_quip.text: Travel to a low health hero and instantly kill it

citadel_ability_shiv_killing_blow_active.text:
Active: Leap forward, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} to the first enemy hero. If they are below the kill threshold, execute them instead.

Finishing an enemy with Killing Blow lets you recast for {s:RecastWindow}s

citadel_ability_shiv_killing_blow_passiv.text: Passive: Damaging enemies fills you with rage. While at full rage, {s:hero_name} gains increased damage and unlocks special properties on his other abilities.
Cooldown is increased by +{s:FailedExecuteCooldownPenalty}% if no hero is impacted.

citadel_ability_shiv_killing_blow_t1_des.text:
+{s:AbilityCastRange} m Range
+{s:BonusMoveSpeed} m/s in Full Rage.

citadel_ability_shiv_killing_blow_t2_des.text:
+{s:BuffDamage}% Full Rage Bonus Damage
{s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown

synth_plasma_flux_quip.text: Launch a damaging cloak that you can teleport to

synth_plasma_flux_desc.text: Launch a sentient cloak that travels forward and damages enemies. You can press {g:citadel_binding:'Ability2'} to teleport to its location.

synth_pulse_quip.text: Briefly escape into your suitcase, then deal damage

synth_pulse_desc.text: Escape into your suitcase. When the duration ends, deal {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} to nearby enemies. Duration can be ended early by performing any action.

synth_pulse_t3_desc.text:
+{s:EscapeDuration}s Duration
+{s:Radius}m Radius
-{s:SlowPercent}% Move Speed and Fire Rate for {s:DebuffDuration}s

synth_barrage_quip.text: Air glide while firing multiple projectiles

synth_barrage_desc.text:
Channel to start launching projectiles that deal {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and apply {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'} around their impact point. Projectiles that hit a hero grant {s:hero_name} {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'DamageAmp'} that stacks.
Casting while airborne will cause {s:hero_name} to float.

Casting AirDash or Flying Cloaking will not cancel Barrage.

synth_barrage_t3_desc.text: +{s:AmpPercentPerStack}% Amp Per Stack and {s:Radius}m Radius

synth_affliction_quip.text: Apply damage over time to enemies nearby

synth_affliction_desc.text:
Applies {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritIcon'}damage over time to enemies nearby.

Affliction's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.

synth_affliction_t3_desc.text:
Prevents all healing
+{s:DPS} DPS with increase Spirit scaling

mirage_tornado_quip.text: Transform yourself into a whirlwind that lifts enemies

mirage_tornado_desc.text: Transform yourself into a whirlwind that travels forward, damaging enemies, slowing their move speed and lifting them up in the air. After emerging from the tornado you gain bullet evasion.

mirage_fire_beetles_quip.text: Send out scarabs that steal life from enemies

mirage_fire_beetles_desc.text: Infest an enemy with fire scarabs, stealing life from them and causing them to deal reduced damage.

mirage_teleport_quip.text: Teleport to an ally or enemy hero

mirage_teleport_desc.text: Target a location on the minimap. After a brief wait, teleport to that location. Taking damage during the wait period causes the teleport to be interrupted.

mirage_teleport_t1_desc.text: +{s:BonusMoveSpeed}m Move Speed and +{s:BonusFireRate}% Fire Rate for {s:MovementSpeedBonusDuration}s

mirage_sand_phantom_desc.text: Active: Consume all Djinn Mark's to deal its damage now.

mirage_sand_phantom_passive_desc.text:
Passive: Your shots apply a Djinn Mark on the target. When the mark expires or is consumed, it deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and the target is briefly revealed on the map. Each added mark doubles the current damage.

There is a per target Cooldown for applying additional marks

mirage_sand_phantom_t1_desc.text: On Proc: Apply a fading {s:MovementSpeedSlow}% Slow for {s:SlowDuration}s

mirage_sand_phantom_t3_desc.text:
{s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown
+{s:DMarkMaxMarks} Max Marks
Stun Victim for {s:StunDuration}s on Max Marks

citadel_ability_tengu_urn_quip.text: Damage and slow enemies in the area

citadel_ability_tengu_urn_desc.text: Summon a patch of choking thorns that damage and slows enemies in its radius.

citadel_ability_tengu_urn_t2_desc.text: +{s:Radius}m Radius and increased DPS Spirit scaling

citadel_ability_tengu_urn_t3_desc.text: Enemies caught in thorns for {s:TimeToEntangle}s are Immobilized for +{s:EntangleDuration}s

citadel_ability_tengu_stone_form_quip.text: Turn into impervious stone and stun enemies nearby

citadel_ability_tengu_stone_form_desc.text: Turn yourself into impervious stone and smash into the ground, stunning and damaging enemies nearby. Heals you for a percentage of your max health.

citadel_ability_tengu_stone_form_t3_desc.text: +{s:StunDuration}s Stun Duration and increased Damage spirit scaling

citadel_ability_tangotether_quip.text: Empower yourself and a nearby ally

citadel_ability_tangotether_desc.text:
Connect with a nearby ally to gain bonuses, replicated healing, and ignore the move speed penalty while shooting.

Receive 50% of Bonuses with no connection
Connection requires line of sight.

citadel_ability_tengu_airlift_quip.text: Death from Above! Fly and drop an ally on enemies

citadel_ability_tengu_airlift_desc.text:
Grab an ally and take flight with them. Drop your ally to cause an explosion, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}. You and your ally gain increased Outgoing Damage when flying ends.

Cooldown reduced by {s:CooldownReductionPctOnOthers}% when used on allies.
Taking damage briefly disables using the ability.
While lifted, your ally cannot attack and deals {s:AllyOutgoingDamagePercent}% damage.

citadel_ability_tengu_airlift_t1_desc.text: On Fly End : {s:AirDropBulletShield} Barrier to {s:hero_name} and ally that scales with Spirit

citadel_ability_tengu_airlift_t3_desc.text:
Silence for {s:AirDropSilenceDuration}s on enemies hit.
Increases damage and barrier scaling.

fathom_scalding_spray_quip.text: Spray scalding water in a cone ahead of you.

fathom_scalding_spray_desc.text: Spray scalding water in a cone ahead of you. You build up bonus weapon damage as the spray damages an enemy hero.

fathom_breach_desc.text: Launch forward, damaging all enemies near where you land and knocking them into the air.

fathom_reefdweller_harpoon_quip.text: Throw a harpoon to pull yourself towards a surface.

fathom_reefdweller_harpoon_desc.text:
Throw a harpoon that latches to a wall or ceiling, and pulls you in. Activates Lurker's Ambush's invisibility while being pulled in. Once hanging attached to the harpoon surface, gain additional charges.

Casting Reefdweller Harpoon does not break invisibility.

fathom_reefdweller_harpoon_passive_desc.text: Passive: While out of combat and hidden on the minimap, heal a portion of your max health every second.

fathom_reefdweller_harpoon_t3_desc.text: After detaching, gain {s:BonusFireRate}% Fire Rate for {s:DetachBuffDuration}s or until you reload

fathom_lurkers_ambush_quip.text: Become invisible and launch an immobilizing spit.

fathom_lurkers_ambush_passive_desc.text: Passive: While out of combat and not seen by enemies, heal a portion of your max health every second. If you stand still, you also become invisible, so long as you stay still or crouched and don't perform any actions. While completely invisible, you are invulnerable.

fathom_lurkers_ambush_active_desc.text:
Hold [{s:ability_key}] to charge up a mouthful of sticky spit that damages and slows enemies. Damage and slow duration increase the longer you hold the spit.
Duration is halved if you are not latched to a wall.

operative_umbrella_maneuver_desc.text: Use your umbrella to catch a gust of wind that lifts you backwards. You then charge up your umbrella to fire a projectile that explodes on impact.

operative_blindside_passive_desc.text: Passive: Deal bonus damage with your gun and melee attacks when hitting an enemy in the back.

operative_blindside_active_desc.text: Active: Throw a concussion grenade that reduces enemies' turn rate.

operative_scattercharge_desc.text: Spin your umbrella, launching numerous charges in a cone ahead of you. They detonate shortly after landing on the ground.

operative_revelation_desc.text: Activate your relic. Enemy heroes nearby have slowed movement and dashes, and receive damage over time when looking towards you. If enemies look at you long enough, they get cursed.

citadel_ability_power_slash_quip.text: Charge up an attack, dealing high damage on a full charge

citadel_ability_power_slash_desc.text:
Channel to increase damage over {s:AbilityCastDelay} seconds, then release a fully-charged sword strike.
Press{g:citadel_binding:'Ability1'}or{g:citadel_binding:'Attack'}to trigger the strike early, dealing partial damage.

citadel_ability_power_slash_t3_desc.text:
+{s:SlashLength}m Cast Range
+{s:FullChargeDamage} Damage and Increases Spirit Power scaling

citadel_ability_flying_strike_desc.text: Throw a grappling hook to reel yourself towards an enemy, dealing Light {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MeleeDamage'} and slowing the target when you arrive.

citadel_ability_flying_strike_t3_desc.text:
Alt-Cast to Grapple allies
+{s:AbilityCastRange}m Cast Range
Gains 1 extra charge

citadel_ability_infinity_slash_desc.text:
Become infused with {s:hero_name}'s shadow soul. After an initial invincible transformation your abilities are refreshed and are 60% faster. You gain immunity to negative status effects and have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist.
When you get a hero kill, you heal and the duration is extended.

citadel_ability_healing_slash_quip.text: Damage enemies nearby, healing on hit

citadel_ability_healing_slash_t2_desc.text: On Hero Hit : +{s:HealMaxHealth}% Max Health Heal

citadel_ability_healing_slash_desc.text: Slash enemies in front of you, damaging them and slowing their fire rate. If any enemy heroes are hit, you heal.

viscous_goo_grenade_desc.text: Throw a ball of goo that deals damage and leaves puddles of goo behind that apply movement slow to enemies in the radius.

viscous_goo_grenade_bounce_desc.text: Multiple hits to the same target deal less damage.

viscous_goo_grenade_quip.text: Damage enemies and make a mess

viscous_goo_grenade_puddle_desc.text:
Goo puddles linger on the ground and apply a movement slow to enemies walking on them.

You and your allies slide faster on goo puddles.

viscous_goo_grenade_t3_desc.text: Bounces {s:MaxBounces} times and improves Spirit Scaling

viscous_restorative_goo_desc.text: Encase the target in a cube of restorative goo that protects from damage, and increases health regen. Target is unable to take any new actions while cubed. Can be used on self. Press {g:citadel_binding:'Mantle'} to escape early.

viscous_restorative_goo_quip.text: The Cube is a safe place to be

viscous_restorative_goo_t1_desc.text: Increases Move Speed and Stamina Recovery

viscous_restorative_goo_t3_desc.text: Removes all non-ult Debuffs and {s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown

viscous_restorative_goo_buff_desc.text: After exiting the cube, the target has increased move speed and stamina recovery for a short duration.

viscous_goo_bowling_ball_desc.text: Morph into a large goo ball that deals damage and stuns enemies on impact. The ball grants large amounts of Bullet and Spirit resist, bounces off walls and can double jump.

viscous_telepunch_desc.text:
Materialize a fist in the world that punches everyone in the area, applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'KnockUp'}.

Punching an enemy deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MeleeDamage'} and applies {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'}.

You and your allies have increased Air Control.

viscous_telepunch_quip.text: Punch enemies with a giant fist

viscous_telepunch_t3_desc.text: {s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown and now deals Heavy Melee Damage

ability_empowerbullet_desc.text:
Performing a Dash or Slide loads your weapon with an empowered bullet that deals bonus Damage, equal to a percentage of your Weapon Damage.

If you're out of bullets, you'll find an extra one. How lucky.

ability_empowerbullet_t1_desc.text: Gain +{s:BonusMoveSpeed} m/s Move Speed while empowered

ability_empowerbullet_t2_desc.text: Deal an additional +{s:BulletArmorReduction}% weapon damage for {s:DebuffDuration}s against the victim

ability_gunslinger_spreadingfire_desc.text:
Throw a projectile, infused with an imp's spirit. It posseses the enemy, dealing Damage over time.

If the target dies while possessed, the imp jumps to another nearby enemy, refreshing its duration.

ability_gunslinger_spreadingfire_t3_desc.text: +{s:DPS} DPS. Spreads to +{s:SpreadTargets} targets after death.

ability_gunslinger_demon_carbine_desc.text: Load your weapon with demonic rounds. After a delay, you empower your next shots to deal bonus damage and penetrate enemies.

ability_gunslinger_salvo_desc.text:
Load your weapon with demonic rounds. After a delay, release a blitz of bullets at the target enemy, dealing bonus Damage.

Enemies can intercept the bullets.

gunslinger_demonMark_desc.text: Passively mark nearby enemies with a Brand. Shooting an enemy with a Brand consumes the effect, dealing bonus Damage and granting Fire Rate and Movement Speed.

ability_viper_hookdagger_desc.text: Throw a blade, dealing Spirit Damage. The blade then hooks back, applying Spirit Damage again and applying a Slow.

ability_viper_hookdagger_quip.text: Throw a blade that returns to you

ability_viper_snakedash_desc.text: You have increased Slide Distance, can Slide up hills, and can turn faster while Sliding.

ability_viper_snakedash_quip.text: Increase the agility of your Slide

ability_viper_venom_desc.text:
Inject a target with lethal venom. After a delay the venom triggers, dealing Spirit Damage. The damage is increased by the target's missing health.

Lethal Venom will ignore Petrify's damage block.

ability_viper_venom_t3_desc.text: Bullets also build up Lethal Venom

ability_viper_venom_quip.text: Inject your enemies with a deadly venom

ability_viper_ult_desc.text: Create a hexed area on the ground. After a delay, ALL units in the cylindrical area are Petrified. Enemies also suffer Spirit Damage. Petrified units block all damage, but cannot take actions.

ability_viper_ult_quip.text: Turn both allies and enemies into stone

ability_viper_petrifybola_desc.text:
Throw an explosive bola. On exploding, the bola Slows and Damages all enemies in the area.

Direct hits deal Additional Damage and Petrify instead. Petrified units block all damage, but cannot take actions.

ability_viper_petrifybola_t3_desc.text: +{s:PetrifyDuration}s Petrify Duration. Petrifies all enemies in the area.
