ability_viper_debuffdagger_desc.text:
Throw a dagger, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'}.

Every subsequent dagger against the same target stacks in {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'}.

ability_viper_debuffdagger_t2_desc.text: On Hit: {s:BulletResistReduction}% Bullet Resist and {s:BulletResistReductionPerStack}% Bullet Resist per Stack

ability_viper_debuffdagger_t3_desc.text:
+{s:MaxStacks} Max Stacks
{s:AbilityCooldownBetweenCharge}s Charge Delay
On Hit: Refund {s:CooldownRefundPercent}% Charge Cooldown

ability_magician_magicbolt_desc.text:
Fire a bolt of magic that deals Damage, increasing as it travels. If you have an Assistant, they also cast Vexing Bolt at reduced damage.

Press {g:citadel_binding:'Ability1'} to redirect the bolt towards your crosshairs.

ability_magician_magicbolt_quip.text: Launch a guided bolt of magic

citadel_ability_magewalkk_desc.text:
Briefly become Untargetable before appearing at your destination. Your first {s:EmpoweredAttackCount} attacks deal bonus Spirit Damage.

[Cast] Appear at the target location.
{g:citadel_binding:'AltCast'} Appear in place.
Enemies will not know which cast you performed.

ability_magician_cloneturret_desc.text:
Summon an Assistant at the targeted location. The Assistant attacks whenever you fire your weapon, dealing Damage.

While the Assistant is out, you can press {g:citadel_binding:'Ability2'} to swap positions with your Assistant.

Casting Spectral Assistant also reloads your weapon.

ability_magician_cloneturret_t3_desc.text: +{s:BonusFireRate}% Fire Rate and +{s:Damage} Assistant Damage

ability_magician_escape_desc.text:
Blink to the target location. On arrival, briefly gain movement speed and become Invisible.

[Cast] Appear at the target location.
{g:citadel_binding:'AltCast'} Appear in place.
Enemies will not know which cast you performed.

ability_magician_animalcurse_desc.text:
Hex a target, transforming them into a Rabbit for a limited duration.

Rabbits are small and move faster, but take increased Damage and are unable to perform most actions.
Hex does not interrupt abilities.

ability_magician_animalcurse_quip.text: Transform your enemy into a rabbit

ability_magician_animalhexarea_desc.text:
Hex a target area and transforming all enemies into a Rabbit for a limited duration.

Rabbits are small and move faster, but take increased Damage and are unable to perform most actions.
Hex does not interrupt abilities.

ability_magician_stage_desc.text: Target an enemy. You and the target enemy are bound on Stage, unable to leave. All other characters are pushed out of the radius.

ability_magician_shadowclone_desc.text:
Create a Copy of yourself with reduced health and damage. When the clone dies or expires it explodes, dealing Spirit Damage.

The Copy cannot use their Ultimate ability.

ability_magician_shadowclone_t3_desc.text: Copy can cast their Ultimate Ability.

ability_magician_bigbolt_desc.text: Prepare three AMAZING bolts of magic. Each bolt applies a Fading Slow and deals Spirit Damage, increased for every bolt fired.

ability_magician_bigbolt_t3_desc.text: +{s:DamagePerShot} Damage Per Bolt. Refund {s:BoltRefundPerKill} Bolt per Kill

ability_magician_copyult_desc.text:
Copy the Ultimate of an enemy hero for a limited time. Reactivating the ability will use the Copied Ultimate instead.

Copies will inherit this ability's upgrade points.
Audience Participation will also copy the cooldown.

ability_magician_copyult_quip.text: Copy an enemy's Ultimate for a limited time

ability_trapper_poisonjar_desc.text: Throw a jar that leaves a spreading toxic pool. Enemies caught in the pool are Slowed and Silenced.

ability_trapper_poisonjar_t3_desc.text: {s:TechArmorDamageReduction}% Spirit Resist for enemies in the pool

ability_trapper_spidershield_desc.text: Apply a Combat Barrier to a target ally and periodically deal Spirit Damage and Slows.

ability_trapper_fear_desc.text:
Dealing Spirit Damage builds an increasing Slow. Once full, the buildup is consumed to apply an Immobilize and a burst of Spirit Damage.

This effect has a cooldown per target.

ability_trapper_webwall_desc.text: Create a thread of web between two surfaces. Enemies who touch the web take Damage over time, become Slowed and are Revealed.

ability_trapper_webwall_t3_desc.text: +{s:DebuffDuration}s Debuff Duration. The Web also Silences for {s:SilenceDuration}s

ability_trapper_spiderwave_desc.text:
Release a wave of spectral spiders that chase enemies and explode, dealing Spirit Damage.

Hit enemies are poisoned, temporarily losing Spirit and Spirit Resist. This effect can stack multiple times.

ability_trapper_spiderwave_quip.text: Release a wave of spectral spiders

ability_vampirebat_doubledagger_desc.text:
Throw two consecutive daggers, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}.

If both daggers hit the same target, deal {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusSpiritDamage'} instead.

ability_vampirebat_doubledagger_t3_desc.text: On Double Hit: Reduce Spirit Resist by {s:TechArmorDamageReduction}% for {s:DebuffDuration}s

ability_vampirebat_lovebites_desc.text:
Your bullets apply additional {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}. Dealing damage your abilities builds up to a vicious bite, dealing a burst of {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusSpiritDamage'}.

Love Bites has a unique cooldown per target.

ability_vampirebat_lovebites_t2_desc.text:
+{s:MagicDamagePerBullet} Spirit Damage per Bullet &
+{s:BonusDamage} Bonus Damage

ability_vampirebat_batblink_t1_desc.text: On Cast: Gain +{s:BonusFireRate}% Fire Rate for {s:BuffDuration}s and add {s:BonusBullets} bullets

ability_vampirebat_batblink_desc.text:
Briefly disperse, becoming untargetable and flying to a target location.

Can be recast within a brief window.

ability_vampirebat_batswarm_desc.text:
Active: Unleash a cloud of bats that seek out targets, each dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Silence'}.

Passive: Triggering Love Bites against heroes permanently increases the number of bats released.

ability_vampirebat_batswarm_t3_desc.text: On Hit: Deal +{s:CurrentHealthPercent}% Current Health as Damage

ability_vampirebat_steallife_desc.text:
Active: Slash with your umbrella, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}, increasing with their missing health. Receive a {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Heal'} for every target killed.

Passive: Holding {g:citadel_binding:'ADS'} causes you to briefly float.
Rake executes non-heroes below {s:TrooperExecuteThreshold} health.

ability_vampirebat_steallife_t3_desc.text: +{s:MissingHealthDamagePercentage}% Missing health damage and increased Heal per Kill Spirit scaling

ability_punkgoat_tether_desc.text:
Chain nearby enemies to you. Chained enemies cannot use movement abilities and receive a heavy {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'} when they pull on the chain.

After a delay, yank everyone towards Billy and deal {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}.

The chain breaks if you lose line of sight for a short while.

ability_punkgoat_tether_t3_desc.text:
+{s:AbilityCastRange}m Range
+{s:UnstoppablePerHero}s of Unstoppable Per Hero pulled in

ability_punkgoat_blastedactive_desc.text: Active: Bullets are amplified against wrecked enemies. Using melee boosts {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MaxHealth'} and extends duration.

ability_punkgoat_blasted_desc.text: Passive: Melee hits restore ammo and inflict wrecked on the victim for {s:BulletDamageAmpDuration}s.

ability_punkgoat_blasted_t2_desc.text: +1 Bashdown Charge on use and +{s:BulletDamageAmp}% Wrecked Bullet Amp

ability_punkgoat_blasted_t3_desc.text: +{s:MaxHealthMelee} Melee Bonus Health and increases spirit scaling

ability_punkgoat_ult_desc.text:
Slam your bat into the ground, {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Pulling'} enemies down and dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MeleeDamage'}.

The slam creates a shockwave that deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and applies {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'KnockUp'}.

ability_punkgoat_ult_t3_desc.text:
{s:AbilityCooldownBetweenCharge}s Charge Time
Now deals 50% Heavy Melee Damage

ability_punkgoat_goatflip_desc.text:
Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy.

Cooldown reduced by 50% on impact.

ability_punkgoat_goatflip_t3_desc.text:
{s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown
On hero hit: +{s:MaxHealthBuffPct}% Max Health for {s:MaxHealthBuffDuration}s

ability_doorman_bomb_desc.text:
Throw out a call bell that deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} on impact. After a short delay it explodes, dealing additional {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and causing affected enemies to suffer reduced weapon accuracy and movement {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'}.

Can be shot to detonate early.

ability_doorman_luggage_cart_desc.text:
Send out a luggage Cart that deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Pulls'} enemy heroes along its path.

Can be alt cast with {g:citadel_binding:'AltCast'} to target friendly heroes instead.

ability_doorman_luggage_cart_t3_note.text: If the cart collides with a wall while dragging an enemy, it will deal bonus damage to the targets.

ability_doorman_luggage_cart_t2_desc.text:
+{s:AbilityCastRange}m Cast Range
+{s:WallImpactDamage} Damage on wall impact

ability_doorman_doorway_desc.text:
Place two connected doors in the world. Players and most projectiles entering one door will exit out through the other. The doors will close at the end of the duration.

The two doors must be placed within the doorway distance of each other.

ability_doorman_doorway_t2_desc.text: Grants a Barrier first time traveling through doors

ability_doorman_doorway_t3_desc.text:
+{s:AbilityCastRange}m Cast Range. +{s:DoorwayDistance}m Doorway Distance
and scales with Spirit Power.

ability_doorman_hotel_desc.text:
Send the target's physical body to be a guest at the Baroness Hotel. The guest is to promptly make their way to the exit elevator, where they'll be sent back to their original position.

A stay at the Baroness Hotel is paid for in {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}. Failure to check-out on time costs additional {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}.

ability_doorman_hotel_t2_desc.text:
+{s:Damage} Damage
+{s:LateCheckoutStun}s Stun on Failure to Check Out

ability_doorman_hotel_t3_desc.text:
Unstoppable while the Baroness is occupied.
{s:LateCheckoutCooldown}s Cooldown on Failure to Check Out.

ability_skyrunner_flakshot_desc.text: Bullets deal {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusWeaponDamage'} and can ricochet off of surfaces.

ability_skyrunner_swingline_desc.text:
Fire a line that attaches to the world, allowing you to swing.

Lifethread resets all air jumps and air dashes.

ability_swan_leap_desc.text: Leap in a target direction. If no direction is chosen, then leap straight up instead.

ability_swan_acrobat_desc.text:
Gain stacking bonuses every time you dash, double jump, wall jump, or teleport.

Gaining new stacks refreshes the duration.

hero_frank_lore.text:
A lot of people spend their whole lives wondering who they really are. For Victor, this existential question is made more complicated as he woke up on a mortuary table with no knowledge of his creator, why he was made, and whom he is made of.

Now searching the five boroughs for answers, Victor is hoping to find someone who can identify any part of him.

ability_frank_shocktarget2_desc.text:
Taking any damage passively charges up your Pain Battery.

Once full, activating the ability fires multiple shocking bolts, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} once per target.

ability_frank_shocktarget2_t1_desc.text: On Hit: Apply {s:SlowPercent}% Slow for {s:SlowDuration}s

ability_frank_shocktarget2_t3_desc.text: On Hero Hit: Heal for {s:MissingHealthPercentHeal}% of your missing health and increased Spirit scaling

ability_frank_shocktarget_desc.text:
Zap a target in front of you, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and applying a brief {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'}.

Incoming damage is stored as additional {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusSpiritDamage'} on your next cast, up to a maximum amount.

ability_frank_shocktarget_desc_t3bonus.text: The target then shocks a nearby target, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDPS'}.

ability_frank_selfzap_desc.text: Deal {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} to yourself. Then, gain bonus {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Regen'} and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusMoveSpeed'}, decaying over time.

ability_frank_painaura_desc.text:
Unleash pain, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDPS'} to both enemies and yourself.

The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.

ability_frank_painaura_t1_desc.text: Enemies receive {s:SlowPercent}% Move and Dash Slow

ability_frank_painaura_t2_desc.text: +{s:MinDPS} Min DPS and +{s:MaxDPS} Max DPS

ability_frank_revive_desc.text:
Release a wave after taking lethal damage, applying a diminishing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'}.

After a brief channel you reanimate, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Stun'} to nearby enemies.

ability_frank_revive_t1_desc.text: While On Cooldown: Gain +{s:BonusFireRate}% Fire Rate and {s:BonusDamagePerBullet} Spirit Damage per Bullet

hero_drifter_lore.text:
An ancient vampire roaming across America, the nameless monstrosity known as The Drifter has been preying on the living for generations.

Unlike most vampires, Drifter doesn’t value finery or titles and has naked contempt for vampiric laws and tradition.  This refusal to toe the line has made him a marked man all over the North American Baronies; but while Viscounts and Elders cry for his execution, Drifter continues to do what he pleases...

drifter_blood_blast_desc.text: Swipe at enemies in a cone ahead of you, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}. If the enemy is in close range, deal bonus {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MeleeDamage'}.

drifter_blood_blast_t3_desc.text:
Deals 55% Heavy Melee Damage
Silences enemies for {s:DebuffDuration}s if close range

drifter_shadow_mark_desc.text:
Send out a mark that bleeds the first target it hits, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDPS'}.

While the enemy is bleeding you can re-activate Stalker's Mark to instantly appear behind their back.

ability_drifter_hunger_passive_desc.text:
Isolated heroes leave a trail as they move, and emit their heartbeat from afar.

You deal amplified damage against isolated heroes, and when isolated heroes die nearby you gain permanent {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'WeaponDamage'}.

ability_drifter_hunger_active_desc.text: Active: Accentuate your senses, revealing a trail that leads to nearby heroes.

ability_drifter_hunger_t1_desc.text: +{s:BonusMoveSpeed}m/s Move Speed when around an isolated enemy hero

ability_drifter_hunger_t2_desc.text: On isolated hero death: Heal {s:HealOnKillPct}% of your missing health and restores {s:StaminaToRestore} Stamina

drifter_darkness_desc.text:
Surround nearby enemy heroes in darkness, severely limiting their vision of other units. Affected enemies are briefly revealed to you and are considered isolated for the duration.

You gain {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusSprintSpeed'}.

drifter_last_breath_desc.text: Encase yourself in a sphere of water that can absorb damage before bursting. When the sphere dissipates for any reason enemies in range take damage.

hero_bookworm_lore.text:
The daughter of a rare book dealer, Paige grew up in a loving home that prioritized kindness, magic, and storytelling.  But while Paige took naturally to her parents' values, her little brother Bryce did not.

A rebellious teen, Bryce resented not only his family’s saccharine attitude, but also their refusal to let him dabble in magics that they deemed too dangerous.  Paige tried everything she could think of to keep him out of trouble, but like most teenagers, the more his big sister tried to tell him what was best for him, the more he turned away.

Paige doesn't know what Bryce did to get kicked out of the house...just that she came home from the library to find her brother gone and her parents crying.

Days turned to weeks, to months, to years.  Paige grew to become a talented bibliomancer, making a living as a storyteller reading at libraries across the five boroughs; and while her parents have remained silent about what happened with Bryce, Paige's obsession with finding him has only grown.  She will discover what happened to her brother... and no man or god is going to stand in her way.

ability_bookworm_dragonfire_desc.text: Conjure a dragon that appears at the target location before flying forward, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and leaving a burning path in its trail.

ability_bookworm_dragonfire_t3_desc.text:
+{s:DragonTravelRange}m Travel Range
+{s:Damage} Damage
+{s:DPS} DPS

ability_bookworm_knightbarrier_desc.text: Grant an ally a {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'CombatBarrier'}. While the barrier holds, they gain {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusWeaponDamage'}.

ability_bookworm_knightbarrier_t3_desc.text:
Affects up to {s:BonusTargets} additional allies.
Increases barrier scaling.

ability_bookworm_aoemagic_desc.text:
Target an area with latent magic, applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'}.

The magic detonates after a delay, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Immobilize'}.

ability_bookworm_aoemagic_t3_desc.text:
+{s:Radius}m Radius
On Hit: Reduce Spirit Resist by {s:TechArmorDamageReduction}% for {s:DebuffDuration}s

ability_bookworm_knightcharge_desc.text:
Release a wave of spectral knights and steeds that charge across the entire city, {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Healing'} allies and dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} to enemies.

The strength of the {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Heal'} and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} is amplified as the knights travel further.

ability_bookworm_knightcharge_t3_desc.text:
+{s:Damage} Damage
+{s:StunDuration}s Stun Duration
+{s:MaxAmp}% Max Amp

ability_boho_bouncyprojectile_desc.text:
Throw a projectile that bounces between targets, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}.

If there are no enemies nearby Skipshot will instead bounce off of Boho, reducing its cooldown.

ability_boho_doublehit_desc.text:
Swing twice, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} to targets in front.

Hits against heroes grant {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusMoveSpeed'} and stacking {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'CombatBarrier'}.

ability_boho_damageshare_desc.text: Enemies hit by {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} are linked to other linked enemies, sharing a portion of incoming damage as {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusSpiritDamage'}.

ability_familiar_ability01_desc.text:
Cast your gaze forward, piercing walls and floors. Enemies in the gaze are slowed, have reduced dash distance, and cannot use movement abilities.

When the channel ends they fall asleep before waking up to a splitting headache that deals heavy {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}.

ability_familiar_ability01_t1_desc.text: -{s:ConsumeStaminaOnWake} Stamina On Wake and no Stamina Regen while sleeping

ability_familiar_ability01_t3_desc.text:
{s:AbilityCooldown}s cooldown
Reduced damage and unstoppable while channeling

ability_familiar_ability02_desc.text:
Throw your trusty pillow inflicting {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and heavy {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'KnockBack'}.

Landing hits reduces the cooldown of your other abilities.

ability_familiar_attach_desc.text:
Jump to an ally and nap alongside them. Both you and the ally receive a burst {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Heal'} based on missing health followed by lingering {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Regen'}.

Hop between allies with {g:citadel_binding:'Ability2'} to apply the heal, once per ally.

You are knocked off if stunned by an ultimate ability.
You can use items and all self-casts target your ally instead.

ability_familiar_attach_t3_desc.text:
+{s:TechPowerPercent}% Spirit Power and +{s:BonusSpiritPower} Spirit Power while napping and for {s:HopOffEffecDuration}s after napping
Improved Spirit Scaling

ability_familiar_attach_t2_desc.text: {s:BonusBarrierAmpPercent}% Bonus Item Range, Duration, and Barrier Effectiveness while napping

ability_familiar_attach_trigger_desc.text: Hop to another ally and refresh the {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Regen'} duration, once per ally.

ability_familiar_helpinghands_desc.text:
Signal a Helper to lend a hand. They can collect boxes, do Sinner's Sacrifices, or be sent to support allies and troopers.

Follow a hero: Provides a short burst of {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritResist'} and fading {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MoveSpeed'}.

Follow a trooper: Provides healing, damage, resists, and allows tagging along. When no hero is around, souls from trooper kills are split amongst the team.

Can be cast during Tag Along. Helpers will take a nap for {s:HelperDowntimeDuration}s after following someone.

ability_necro_hauntingskull_desc.text:
Passive: Collect death when anything dies nearby and store it in your Jar of Dead.

Active: Throw a jar to summon Deadheads that repeatedly deal {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} to enemies.

Deadheads follow you instead if there's no nearby enemies, and prioritize the target of your weapon.

ability_necro_hauntingskull_t1_desc.text: Collecting death heals {s:HealPerPickup} health per pickup

ability_necro_hauntingskull_t2_desc.text: On Hit: Apply {s:SlowPercent}% Slow for {s:SlowDuration}s

ability_necro_zombiewall_desc.text:
Unearth a line of grasping hands, summoning a Ghoul and leaving behind a rift. Enemies who pass through take {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and receive {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Immobilize'}.

Alt-Cast {g:citadel_binding:'AltCast'} rotates the orientation of the wall.

ability_necro_zombiewall_t3_desc.text:
+{s:GhoulCount} Ghouls Raised
{s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown
+{s:ImmobilizeDuration}s Immobilize Duration

ability_necro_fear_desc.text: Your weapon steals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'WeaponDamage'} and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritResist'} over time, up to a maximum amount per target.

ability_necro_fear_t3_desc.text:
+{s:MaxStolenTargets} Max Steal Targets
All Summons now apply Essence Theft

ability_necro_gravestone_desc_1.text: Innate: Abilities can summon Ghouls that shamble toward the enemy base, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MeleeDamage'}. They explode when they approach a hero or objective, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} in an area and applying a brief {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'}

ability_necro_gravestone_desc_2.text: Active: Create a gravestone at a target location that summons Ghouls over time. Enemies can destroy the gravestone with two heavy melees.

ability_necro_gravestone_t3_desc.text: On Death: Deal +{s:CurrentHealthDamagePercentage}% Current Health as Damage

ability_necro_summonskele_desc.text:
Unearth a buried ghoul that shambles towards the enemy base, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MeleeDamage'}.

It explodes when it dies or approaches a hero, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and applying a brief {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'}.

Alt-Cast {g:citadel_binding:'AltCast'} causes the spawned ghoul to remain in place.
Ghouls prioritize the target of your weapon.

ability_necro_summonskele_t3_desc.text: +{s:GhoulHealth} Ghoul Health, and Ghouls also unearth at every Gravestone

ability_necro_killsummon_desc.text:
Kill a Ghoul or low-health ally, gaining their lifeforce.

{g:citadel_binding:'Attack'}: Throw the lifeforce as a bomb, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}.
{g:citadel_binding:'AltCast'}: Consume the lifeforce, receiving {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Healing'}.

ability_necro_coffin_desc.text:
Gain a {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'CombatBarrier'} and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusMoveSpeed'}.

When the barrier expires you release a ring of necrotic energy, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'}.

ability_necro_haunt_desc.text:
Grant an ally {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusMoveSpeed'} and spectres which orbit around them.

The spectres will seek nearby enemies, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'}.

ability_necro_wither_desc_1.text: Enemies hit by your weapon begin to wither, applying increasing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'} and reduced {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritResist'}.

ability_necro_wither_desc_2.text:
Enemies who die while withered spawn Deadheads that chase nearby enemies, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}.

Deadheads will follow you instead if there are no enemies nearby.
Deadheads will prioritize the target of your weapon.

ability_werewolf_transformation_desc.text:
Passive: Dealing damage generates bloodlust, increased at low health. At max bloodlust, you automatically cast Lycan Curse.

Active: Instantly transform, gaining increased {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MaxHealth'}, and stacking {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'FireRate'} on enemy heroes, and replacing your abilities and weapon with their ferocious versions.

ability_werewolf_transformation_t2_desc.text: +{s:BonusMoveSpeed} m/s Move Speed and {s:BonusHealth} Bonus Health

ability_werewolf_transformation_t3_desc.text: On Hero Kill: Refresh abilities and duration

ability_werewolf_transformation_trigger_.text: Return back to your human form.

ability_werewolf_passive_desc.text:
Human:Track the last hero you hit. Killing tracked enemies grants bonus souls.

Werewolf:Track any low-health heroes nearby. Killing tracked heroes reduce your cooldowns.

ability_werewolf_netshot_desc.text: Throw a bola, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}, applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'} and preventing movement abilities or stamina.

ability_werewolf_netshot_t3_desc.text:
+{s:DebuffDuration}s Debuff Duration.
Bola ricochets to {s:RicochetCount} additional targets

ability_werewolf_kickflip_desc_1.text: Dash forward and kick the first enemy hit, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MeleeDamage'} while pushing yourself off and marking them.

ability_werewolf_kickflip_desc_2.text: Shooting the marked target deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and removes the mark.

ability_werewolf_kickflip_t3_desc.text: +{s:BonusDamage} Bonus Damage and kicked enemies deal {s:OutgoingDamagePercent}% Damage for {s:DebuffDuration}s

ability_werewolf_unloadgun_desc.text:
Instantly reload your gun. You gain {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusFireRate'} and deal bonus {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'WeaponDamage'} based on the target's health for a limited number of shots, but suffer from reduced accuracy.

Deals bonus Weapon Damage against troopers and neutrals.

ability_werewolf_unloadgun_t3_desc.text: If you hit all shots, deal +{s:BonusCurrentHealthDamagePercentage}% current health as damage

ability_werewolf_frenzy_desc.text: Deal {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MeleeDamage'} to all enemies in front of you, receiving a {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Heal'} for a portion of the damage dealt. The damage is increased the lower health they have.

ability_werewolf_maulingleap_desc.text: Leap forward, mauling the first enemy hit for {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MeleeDamage'}. They suffer from reduced {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BulletResist'} and take {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} over time.

ability_werewolf_cripplingslash_desc.text: Smash enemies around you, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}. They suffer from disarm and a brief {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'}.

ability_werewolf_onthehunt_desc.text: Gain {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusFireRate'} and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusMoveSpeed'}, half to nearby allies. Kills during this time recasts On The Hunt.

ability_werewolf_leap_desc.text: Leap through the air before landing, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MeleeDamage'} and applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'} to nearby enemies while pushing them away.

ability_werewolf_leap_t1_desc.text: On Landing: +{s:BonusMoveSpeed} m/s Move Speed for {s:LandingBonusesDuration}s

ability_priest_knockback_desc.text: Fire a blast with your shotgun, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'WeaponDamage'} and pushing enemies back. Enemies near a wall receive {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Stun'} and take {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BonusWeaponDamage'}.

ability_priest_knockback_t3_desc.text: On Wall Stun: Your next heavy melee is blessed

ability_priest_selfheal_desc.text:
Burn your censer, reducing incoming damage and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Healing'} over time.

You cannot attack while Potent Vapors is active.

ability_priest_stackingdefense_desc.text: Taking damage grants stacking {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BulletResist'} and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritResist'} that expires over time.

ability_priest_smokegrenade_desc.text: Throw a tear gas grenade that detonates after a delay, blocking vision. Enemies in the area have {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'ReducedFireRate'}.

ability_priest_smokegrenade_t2_desc.text: On Debuff: Drain {s:StaminaDrain} Stamina per Second

ability_priest_barrage_desc.text: Equip your crossbow, changing your weapon to deal {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'PureDamage'} and apply a brief {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'}.

ability_priest_weaponswap_desc.text:
Load your crossbow with 3 stakes, dealing massively increased {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'WeaponDamage'}.

The final stake is blessed, dealing bonus {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'PureDamage'} and executing low-health enemies.

ability_priest_weaponswap_t1_desc.text: While Active: Gain {s:BonusMoveSpeed} m/s Move Speed

ability_priest_weaponswap_t2_desc.text: {s:AbilityCooldown}s Ability Cooldown and +{s:BonusDamage} Bonus Damage

ability_priest_antispiritvest_desc.text: Gain passive {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'CombatBarrier'} that grants {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BulletResist'} and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritResist'}. The barrier repairs itself when out of combat.

ability_priest_antispiritvest_t3_desc.text: On Barrier Break: Gain {s:BaseAttackDamagePercent}% Weapon Damage for {s:BuffDuration}s

ability_priest_silencebomb_desc.text: Throw a censer that leaves a spreading cloud. Enemies caught in the cloud are Slowed and Silenced.

ability_priest_flashbang_desc.text:
Fire a grenade that bounces before exploding, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'WeaponDamage'} and setting enemies on fire.

Burning targets deal {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'PureDamage'} to enemies in the area and suffer from reduced healing.

ability_priest_beartrap_desc.text:
Kick a trap that arms after a brief delay.

The trap springs on the first enemy it touches, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}, applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Immobilize'}, and revealing enemies for a duration afterwards.

ability_unicorn_radiantblast_desc.text: Blast enemies in a cone in front of you with a flare of light. Blasted enemies take {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} when attacked by {s:hero_name} and provides her spirit lifesteal.

ability_unicorn_prismaticguard_desc.text: Surround yourself in a protective prism. If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage.

ability_unicorn_prismaticguard_t2_desc.text: +{s:CombatBarrier} Barrier and Increased Barrier Spirit Scaling

ability_unicorn_prismaticguard_t3_desc.text: +{s:DebuffDuration} Silence Duration and {s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown. Allows Shining Wonder Bounce.

ability_unicorn_dazzlingorb_desc.text:
Launch a deadly orb of light that deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and applies {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'} and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets.

Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.

ability_unicorn_luminousstrike_desc.text:
Call down a beam of light from the sky. After a short duration, the beam will fully form, causing an explosion that deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} to all targets in the area.

Celeste will receive a stacking buff that increases her spirit damage anytime this hits an enemy hero.

ability_unicorn_luminousstrike_t3_desc.text: +{s:MagicIncreasePerStack}% Spirit Amp and +{s:FireRatePerStack}% Fire Rate Per Stack

ability_fencer_throwblade_desc.text: Draw a sigil sphere in front of you and then leap backwards as it explodes, damaging and slowing enemies caught in it.

ability_fencer_throwblade_t1_desc.text: Gain +{s:BonusFireRate}% Fire Rate and +{s:BonusBulletSpeedPercent}% Bullet Speed for {s:BuffDuration}s

ability_fencer_throwblade_t2_desc.text: On Player Hit: +{s:StaminaToRestore} stamina restored and resets Air Jump/Dash limit

ability_fencer_lunge_desc.text:
Perform a series of lunges in any direction, delivering piercing stabs ahead of you. Hold your ability key to time your attacks, dealing more damage the longer it's held. Releasing your attack during the perfect window deals maximum damage.

Press {g:citadel_binding:'Ability3'} to re-cast.

ability_fencer_lunge_t2_desc.text: {s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown. Gain +{s:BulletResist}% Bullet Resist during lunge

ability_fencer_lunge_t3_desc.text:
+{s:PerfectDamage} Perfect Damage with improved Spirit scaling.
Increased lunge speed & distance.

ability_fencer_riposte_desc.text:
Prepare to deflect the next incoming attack. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and target an enemy hero to dash towards them, stunning them and reducing their Melee Resist.

Press {g:citadel_binding:'Ability2'} to select a target.
Does not trigger against trooper or neutral damage.

ability_fencer_riposte_attack_desc.text: Perform a quick dash forward and stun an enemy with your weapon's pommel.

ability_fencer_riposte_t3_desc.text: Gain {s:TargetLifesteal}% Bullet, Spirit & Melee Lifesteal against the Riposte target for {s:TargetLifestealDuration}s

ability_fencer_ultimate_desc.text:
Charge up and perform a long range slash. Struck enemies cannot take action or heal and are stuck in slow motion. When this effect expires, they suffer devastating damage, dealing bonus damage against half-health enemies.

While in slow motion, Apollo is invulnerable and enemies take reduced damage.

Hold {g:citadel_binding:'Ability4'} or {g:citadel_binding:'Attack'} to delay the cast.

citadel_weapon_hero_atlas_set_desc.text: Reloads single shells at a time. Can be interrupted

citadel_weapon_hero_forge_set_desc.text: Increases fire rate as the guns spins up

citadel_weapon_hero_bebop_set_desc.text: Fires a continuous beam with no bullet travel

hero_bebop_role.text: Hooks an enemy for a knockout combo

hero_forge_role.text: Controls the battle with combat turrets

hero_ghost_role.text: Sacrifices health then drains it back

hero_inferno_role.text: Lights up enemies and watches them burn

hero_lash_role.text: Dives down to stomp his foes

hero_shiv_role.text: Bleeds out foes, then goes in for a kill

hero_warden_role.text: Weakens his enemies and chases them down

hero_tengu_role.text: Sets up a power duo with a lucky ally

hero_mirage_role.text: Times his shots and catches fleeing targets

hero_slork_role.text: Slips into combat and then hides to recover

hero_astro_playstyle.text: Holliday depends on her skills as a crack shot, shooting things she's bounced into the air. With good aim she can lay out heavy damage. Her movement skills let her isolate her enemies or beat a hasty retreat.

hero_atlas_playstyle.text: Abrams has the bulk and sustain to lead from the front, often running into the middle of his foes and watching them scatter. If his enemies waste their fire on him, his backline teammates can lay out damage with impunity.

hero_bebop_playstyle.text: Bebop can string together his abilities in many different ways. Disrupting enemy positions, saving an ally or dealing bursts of damage. When the situation doesn't require subtlety his giant laser still solves many problems.

hero_wrecker_playstyle.text: Salvaging and scrapping for parts, Wrecker can disassemble troopers, crush foes with his Wrecking Ball, and capture all enemies in his Stasis Trap.

hero_chrono_playstyle.text: Manipulating time lets Paradox outpace an enemy in one on one combat. She thrives by subjecting her enemies to timely swaps into a waiting pulse grenade, her wall, or into the middle of her teammates.

hero_dynamo_playstyle.text: Dynamo keeps himself and his allies healthy while waiting for his moment. Few things can warp a team fight more than a well-coordinated use of Singularity.

hero_forge_playstyle.text: Precise placement is everything for McGinnis, whether she's creating a killzone or splitting the enemy team. She can help keep her team running making them hard to dislodge when entrenched.

hero_ghost_playstyle.text: Expending health to achieve devastating effects is the source of Lady Geist's power. When running low, she can drain the life out of her rivals.

hero_gigawatt_playstyle.text: Seven thrives in a skirmish waiting for the time to strike. Then he rolls into the fight like a storm and batters his enemies with a cascade of lightning.

hero_haze_playstyle.text: When Haze fixates on a target she can hold her own in a firefight. She prefers to create one sided exchanges, avoiding damage then picking off unsuspecting targets up close.

hero_hornet_playstyle.text: Vindicta has the mobility to engage at her leisure, picking at her prey and bleeding them out slowly. Injured enemies at any distance should fear being picked off when she is on the map.

hero_inferno_playstyle.text: Infernus has many ways to deal damage over time, burning foes before swooping in for the kill. Due to Infernus' blazing speed, his enemies won't be able to escape the flames.

hero_kelvin_playstyle.text: Timely heals and splitting a teamfight properly is the difference between an easy victory or a ruinous defeat. Gliding around slowing enemies gives Kelvin's team the maneuvering advantage to make this happen.

hero_lash_playstyle.text: Lash gives his enemies little room to breathe, either by flying in from long distances to initiate combat with unsuspecting enemies, or pursuing said enemies when they try to run.

hero_krill_playstyle.text: By burrowing through the ground, Mo and Krill can get the drop on almost anyone; and once they get in close the results can be devastating.

hero_nano_playstyle.text: Calico uses the shadows to her advantage, weaving in and out of combat to hunt down her enemies one by one.

hero_orion_playstyle.text: A cunning predator, Grey Talon uses a combination of deadly accuracy, traps, and clever positioning to bring down the toughest of opponents.

hero_shiv_playstyle.text: Shiv has zero interest in playing fair, which is why he relies on hit and run tactics to weaken enemies before he dives in for the kill.

hero_viscous_playstyle.text: Viscous vexes his opponents through clever evasion and strategic uses of healing, enabling him to withstand the most brutal of enemy attacks.

hero_warden_playstyle.text: Warden leads from the front, jumping into the fray and hindering his opponents' ability to fight effectively. But what Warden considers brave, others consider reckless, and if he's not careful he can easily find himself in over his head.

hero_wraith_playstyle.text: Excelling at one-on-one combat, Wraith isolates targets, eliminating them with ruthless efficiency. Then teleporting away before anyone can retaliate.

hero_yamato_playstyle.text: Yamato uses precise strikes to decimate her rivals. However, such damaging attacks often will leave her exposed, so she needs to make every shot count.

hero_synth_playstyle.text: With a powerful shotgun and a thin frame, Pocket relies on their ability to briefly escape into a mystic suitcase and teleport via a flying cloak in order to survive close encounters.

hero_mirage_playstyle.text: Mirage can envelop himself in a violent tornado to catch up to enemies and lift them up. His scarabs help him sustain against multiple enemies, and he's always ready to help an ally or punish an enemy anywhere.

hero_slork_playstyle.text: A short-ranged assassin, Fathom can slip in and out of combat and win long engagements.

hero_tengu_playstyle.text: Ivy has disruptive combat tricks that slow and stun enemies. She's most effective when linking up with an ally, empowering her and her ally's guns as well as sharing heals.

hero_viper_playstyle.text: With a powerful weapon (and deadly venom to match), Vyper can slither into the back of teams and assassinate high-priority targets in a storm of bullets.

hero_magician_playstyle.text: With the help of their unwilling assistant, The Magnificent Sinclair can confuse enemies with curving hexes and rapid bolts.

hero_trapper_playstyle.text: The Trapper can infest the battlefield with their haunted spiders, leaving latent curses in key areas. If you let the Trapper have their way, you won't be able to navigate the map without springing some sort of trap.

hero_operative_playstyle.text: By impeding enemy movement and punishing those who look in his direction, Raven creates opportunites to stab his enemies in the back.

hero_astro_lore.text:
There are people who spent their whole lives dreaming about moving to New York.  Holliday isn't one of those people.  Content with being a Sheriff in a small town, Holliday enjoyed a career where the only time she had to use her gun was when trick shooting at the county fair...then the murders started.

Grisly and inhumane; the bodies were found with their ribcages ripped open... their innards picked apart as if by birds.  Holliday tracked down the killer, a travelling folk musician that the media dubbed "The Troubadour", but when she confronted him he exploded into a murder of crows and flew away.

That was 6 months ago, and while the murders in central Illinois have stopped, Holliday's investigation has not.  She believes that The Troubadour is travelling to New York, and when she finds him she's going to kill that evil son of a bitch.

hero_atlas_lore.text:
Hard hitting, hard headed, and hard drinking; Detective Abrams has been a fixture on the New York investigating scene for years.  From stolen art, to missing persons, to ritual murders; Abrams didn't just take any case that came across his desk... he solved them.

But his days of following cheating spouses came to an end the day he opened his office door and found The Tome sitting on his desk.

No instruction was left for him save for a brief note scrawled in onyx blood that read "Don't let them have it".  Abrams hasn't figured where the thing came from; but seeing as his home has been broken into, his office tossed on 3 different occasions, and his car firebombed he has a vested interest in figuring out what the hell is going on.

hero_bebop_lore.text: Forged by the hands of a widowed junk yard attendant; Bebop was more than just some scrap golem laborer... he was the son she couldn't have.  Together they would work in the iron yard during the day, and listen to jazz at night. It was a predictable, if not comforting routine.  But now, Bebop's creator has fallen ill and while Miss Shelly wouldn't approve of the activities that Bebop does at night to pay for her medicine, what she doesn't know can't hurt her.

hero_wrecker_lore.text:
When the Maelstrom  first hit New York, it didn’t just usher in a new age of mysticism to the world… it changed geopolitics.  From CIA employed seers identifying threats decades before they rise to power to occult pacts made in smoky backrooms;  countless wars and atrocities have been prevented that would otherwise have shaped history.  But that doesn’t mean there is no war… just that war has changed.

Paranormal Military Companies have risen to prominence.  These groups, using a combination of extra-planar creatures and various blood magics; have found ways to circumvent the guardrails established by the nation’s watchdog oracles, allowing them to function as proxies for nations seeking to wage war.

Wrecker is one such soldier.

Employed by Eldritch Tactical Solutions (a subsidiary of Fairfax Industries), Wrecker is an elite soldier of fortune with a reputation for doing dirty work that other PMC’s don’t have the stomach for.

hero_chrono_lore.text:
Paradox.  An artifact of time, and the name of a notorious thieves' guild... one that prides themselves on constructing elaborate heists that target the most untouchable of individuals and institutions.  What does Paradox do with the countless artifacts, state secrets, and celebrity paternity tests that they have stolen?  Put it on display at pop-up museums, so that they can show the world that no one is out of Paradox’s reach.

Shrouded in mystery, each member of Paradox dons a mask and takes on the organization's name.  They are everywhere.  They are nowhere.  And if they want something, they are inevitable.

hero_dynamo_lore.text:
As a Scientist, Professor Dynamo always had an inquisitive mind.  So when a rift in space and time opened up in central park he was first on the scene to investigate – and while he expected such a majestic sight to be life changing, he was thinking more in a metaphorical way as opposed to having his body atomized and reduced to a tiny dying star.

But while his body is gone, his spirit and lust for knowledge lives on.  A tenured professor at Columbia College, Dynamo looks to learn more about his condition while maintaining his class load, after all: he has future minds to inspire.

hero_forge_lore.text:
Maggie McGinnis always had a knack for building things.  At 4 she was using Lincoln Logs to recreate architectural marvels.  At 10 she built and rewired a custom light fixture for her parent's anniversary.  At 15 she designed a machine that refined the souls of the dead...that last one got a little more attention than the Lincoln Logs.

Now the head of Fairfax Industries Military R&D department, McGinnis spends her time in the machine shop, not in a lab.  She's not interested in theory, to her science is magic you can touch.

hero_ghost_lore.text:
Once, Lady Jeanne Geist was the toast of the town.  But as time passed and her beauty faded she found herself further and further from her glory days in High Society until finally she was nothing more than a frail woman in a nursing home, telling stories of a glorious past.  And that’s when Oathkeeper revealed himself.  A powerful spirit from another plane, Oathkeeper offered her a path to reclaim her past glories… he could restore her youth; all she had to do was drain the essence of the living to sustain herself. 

Geist was torn.  Obviously murder was ghoulish business, and undoubtedly Oathkeeper was not an entity that could be trusted… but still, the thought of having a second chance of reliving her youth was too good to pass up.  And so she concocted a plan: after making a pact with Oathkeeper she would bind and ward him, limiting his influence and pull over her.  Oathkeeper would still get fed; but on her terms, not his.

However, as years have turned to decades; the strength of the Ward has weakened, and Oathkeeper hungers more than he ever has in the past…

hero_gigawatt_lore.text:
When mystic energy awoke on Earth, the world changed... anything was possible.  But just because anything WAS possible, didn’t mean that anything SHOULD be possible.  And so the government made rules.   Laws.  A means for US citizens to enjoy the benefits of the supernatural world in safety.  But rules and laws are for lesser men.  Men with limitations.  Men who were not Seven.  

There are many rumors about what Seven did to land himself in Lost Whisper, an oubliette for the most dangerous of occultists.  But there is no doubt about what happened on the night of his execution. 

Wards placed by the most powerful ritualists of 7 different nations… wards designed to not just prevent mystical interference with the execution, but to simultaneously obliterate Seven's soul so that it could never be contacted, resurrected, or otherwise be used by someone looking to follow in his footsteps... failed.

Onlookers viewed in horror as the strongest mentalist employed by the US Army’s head popped like a grape.  They screamed as Scotland Yard’s premiere occult investigator, the one who allegedly captured Seven, crumbled to ash.  Seven's body buckled and writhed against his restraints; his skin burning from eldritch electricity... and yet he would not die.  He laughed.

He laughed as he tore himself free from his bondage.

He laughed as his captors cowered in fear.

He laughed as he massacred his tormentors.

He laughed as he tasted the fresh air that was denied to him for years.

And he laughed when he thought about what he was going to do once he reached New York City.

hero_haze_lore.text:
The Occult Security and Investigation Commission is a black box government organization that makes the CIA look transparent.  It falls on the men, women, and entities of the OSIC to keep the country safe from sinister forces that are beyond the capabilities of local law enforcement.

As a member of the notorious Sandman Division, Haze is routinely tasked with infiltrating the dreams of persons of interest, to assess their threat level, and if needed... to put them to sleep.

hero_hornet_lore.text:
A victim of John Hathorne during the Salem Witch Trials, Vindicta got a second chance of life when her spirit was brought back to the mortal plane during the first Maelstrom (the event that introduced the supernatural to the public at large).

Waging a one ghost war against "The Friends of Humanity", a neo inquisition formed by Hathorne's descendants; Vindicta looks to keep the supernatural safe from Hathorne's ilk, and she isn't afraid to stack as many bodies as needed to do it.

hero_inferno_lore.text: Like most teenagers; Infernus was wild, rebellious, and impetuous.  Unlike most teenagers, Infernus was a creature from another plane and had a supernatural mastery over fire.  Needless to say:  his youth was filled with no small amount of arson, murder, and evidence disposal.  But that was then.  Now an adult, Infernus has mellowed out considerably.  He’s happy working at a bar with good live music, and talking to interesting people.  That being said when someone at the bar gets belligerent or violent, he’s not afraid to dust off the skills he once honed.

hero_kelvin_lore.text:
A famed adventuring scientist, Kelvin made it his life's mission to explore and understand the unknowable.  So naturally when rumors surfaced regarding an 8th astral gate hidden in the arctic, Kelvin couldn't build an expedition team fast enough.  Assembling the brightest minds of his generation, Kelvin and his team set forth with much fanfare.

They never returned.

A year and a half later the frozen body of Kelvin was found by a fishing trawler, his corpse clutching a rock etched with glowing runes.  The crew chipped away at the ice, looking to get a closer look at the body and were shocked when Kelvin opened his eyes.  They checked his vitals... there was no pulse.  They sought to bandage his open wounds... there was no blood.  And yet, impossibly, Kelvin was "alive".

Having no memory of what happened on the expedition, Kelvin is looking for answers.

hero_krill_lore.text: Mo and Krill are members of The Tunnel Rats, a group that help facilitate illicit trade and commerce between the boroughs thanks to a network of underground tunnels.  But while most denizens of the New York underworld respect the work The Rats do, every once in a while a gang tries to exploit the tunnel system for personal vendettas...that's when Mo and Krill step in and remind the city what happens to those who disrespect their hospitality.

hero_nano_lore.text:
Once a decorated member of The Baxter Society, Calico left the august order once she realized that killing monsters for free was less profitable than killing people for money.

Now an in demand contract killer, Calico is living her best life ending someone else's.

hero_orion_lore.text:
A founding member of "The Baxter Society", Wesley Grey Talon spent close to 40 years hunting monsters that preyed on man before finally deciding to find a replacement and lay down his bow. Grey Talon's duties had meant that he never spent much time with his wife and kid, and now that his son had started a family of his own he realized that this was his last chance to reconnect with the people he loved.

Retirement suited Wesley.  He made up for lost time with his wife.  He doted on his grandkids.  He cooked dinner for the whole family every Wednesday.  He was happy.

Then he got the call.

The authorities claimed that it was a freak accident... that the fire consumed his son's house before anyone got a chance to escape.  But Wesley knew better.  His son's wife was an Ixian who could snuff out flame with a thought.  If their bodies were found burned they had to be dead long before there was a fire.

And so Grey Talon has picked up his bow once more, and when he finds who's responsible there will be a bloody reckoning.

hero_shiv_lore.text:
A loyal member of "The Baxter Society", an international order of monster hunters, Shiv travels across North America looking to put down creatures that prey on the living.

While his less polished nature and criminal past make some of the more traditional members of the Society wary, no one can deny his effectiveness.

hero_viscous_lore.text:
The Bermuda Triangle was never a myth, it was a shadowline nexus deep underneath the Atlantic Ocean.  For the most part, the things that escaped this astral gate were benign (like Nessie), but now something dark and predatory known only as The Adversary hunts the seas... and ocean denizens are scared to death.

One of those inhabitants, a psychic sea anemone, wants to do something about it.  Summoning an ectoplasmic goo body to traverse the surface, Viscous is desperately trying to summon the Patrons in order to keep The Deep safe from the horror that lurks below.

hero_warden_lore.text:
Most people think the supernatural came into the world 50 years ago.  They’re wrong.  Its presence shaped folklore for generations… and as long as there have been people afraid of the shadows, there have been those who dedicated their lives to fighting in them.

Coming from a lineage of militant alchemists, Warden’s family always trained for the day they would have to stave off a mystic apocalypse… but as time passed the importance of the lessons seemed less and less important.  What once was viewed as a sincere warning slowly morphed into being perceived as amusing anecdotes told by their superstitious grandparents.

When the portal opened in Central Park, Warden’s parents realized not only was everything they were told was true, they were unprepared.  Refusing to let the next generation fall asleep on the job, Warden was trained since birth to be a supernatural killing machine with one purpose: stopping the Patrons from ever entering our world.

hero_wraith_lore.text: The cornerstone of the New York gambling scene, Wraith's organization is about as open a secret as it comes.  However, thanks to a non-trivial amount of bribes, shakedowns, and blackmail, Wraith knows that she's above the law.

hero_yamato_lore.text:
犯罪組織のボスの家に生まれた花桜梨とその兄の大和にとって、
父の死後に「セブンスムーン」の跡目を継ぐのは自明のことでもあった。
そして何年もの間、かれらは対等の立場で組織を率いて利益と成功を
もたらし、やがてはアメリカへの進出をも目論むようになった。

思い描いていた計画は単純で、 大和がアメリカに渡って花桜梨の
国際的な存在感を高め、その間花桜梨は日本に残って国内を統制する、
といったものだった。 兄妹にとって不運だったのは、花桜梨が日本で
指揮をとるという計画を快く思わない部下たちがいたことだった。

そして迅速かつ暴力的な形で、反乱は発生した。大和は花桜梨を
守るために命を落とし、花桜梨と数人の忠実な部下たちは、
その大和の犠牲のおかげもあって、日本からアメリカへと
逃げ延びることに成功した。

アメリカに着いた花桜梨たちを出迎えたのは、本来であれば大和が
会う予定となっていた男であった。彼は日本人の名前になじみが
なかったため性別の区別がついておらず、花桜梨のことを
「ヤマト」と呼んだ。花桜梨は男の間違いを正そうと思ったが、
結局そのままにした。兄の記憶を残し続けるためにも、その名を名乗り、
その夢を受け継ぐことが最善の道であろうと考えたからだ。

hero_tengu_lore.text:
The gargoyle didn't know what was happening when it sprang to life...  just that a big human and a small human were being hurt.  And so the gargoyle leapt to action, sending the attackers fleeing in horror.  The small human said thank you and asked the gargoyle's name.  The gargoyle didn't have one.  And so the small human said, "I'm going to call you Ivy."  The gargoyle, being covered in ivy at the time, thought it was a bit obvious, but decided to go along with it for the small human's sake.

The humans asked if Ivy would come home with them so they could show their appreciation, and so Ivy walked with them.  That night she learned much.  The family were called The Arroyo's.  The little one, Sophia.  Mofongo is what they called a plate of deliciousness.  But most importantly, she learned that the people attacking them were called "The Mendoza Syndicate", and they were hurting people...nice people like The Arroyo's.

18 years have passed since the day the Arroyo's took Ivy home... and during that time she made it her mission to dismantle the Mendoza Syndicate and free Spanish Harlem from its grasp.  However the thing about dedicating your life to a single pursuit for nearly 2 decades is that you don't really know what to do once you achieve it.  For the first time in her life, Ivy is prepared to venture outside of Spanish Harlem and see what the world has to offer beyond vigilante justice.

hero_synth_lore.text:
Arin Fairfax, the eldest heir to Fairfax Industries, has been living in hiding for the past 5 years after being shot and left for dead on their 18th birthday.  Arin doesn't know who is trying to keep them from taking control of their parent's company... but in the avarice fueled viper's nest that is Fairfax Industries it could be anyone.

Taking on the name "Pocket", Arin desperately wants to keep their true identity a secret… not only for their own protection; but because they want to forge their own identity separate from their parents.

hero_mirage_lore.text:
The Djinn are one of the more curious groups of people in the modern world.  Possessing great power in controlled doses, Djinn are incapable of maintaining corporeal form for longer than 48 minutes without resting within a vessel.  As a result, most Djinn employ human bodyguards for transport, protection, and companionship.

Mirage is one such bodyguard.  Employed by Djinn ambassador Nashala Dion, Mirage is in New York on a diplomatic mission.  It's the hope of the Djinn that they can negotiate with the US government for a sale of part of Wyoming so that they can build a sovereign nation for their people.

hero_slork_lore.text: A notorious monster of The Deep, Fathom enjoyed cultivating an aura of mystery and fear around him.  He was content feasting on wayward sailors and demanding tithes from selkies, but then The Adversary came and ruined everything.  After all, when it came to sowing terror, how could he compete with a genocidal force of nature?  It wasn't fair.  Something had to be done to save himself from fading into obscurity...and so he seeks to summon the Patrons to ensure that he will always be the apex predator of The Deep.

hero_viper_lore.text:
When it comes to breaking the law, not getting caught is a pretty important part of the job.  Vyper never got that memo.  Luckily for her, if there’s one thing she’s better at than being arrested, it’s escaping out of jail.

Having done time in every major prison in the tri-state area, Vyper has built an impressive network of street level lowlifes that owe her one.  She’s also built an impressive network of street level lowlifes that want her dead, but she tries to focus on the positive.

hero_magician_lore.text:
Henry's parents told him he was too young and impulsive to mess with real magic, and so they gave him a deck of cards to play with.  He took to sleight of hand naturally and soon was dazzling his classmates with fantastic feats of illusions that were done without mystic artifacts or incantation.

When he was in high school he met Savannah, and their mutual love of stage magic sparked a whirlwind romance.  Soon they fell in love and created an act together.  Obviously they were meant to be; and so at prom, Henry proposed to Savannah and they married soon after graduation.

Unsurprisingly both sets of parents were not thrilled at this prospect, but Henry and Savannah knew they were soulmates.  And so they cemented their love for one another by having a blood mystic bind their souls for eternity.

When an on-stage accident claimed both their lives, no one was sure who to blame.  Henry claims Savannah was out of position.  Savannah says Henry didn't wait for his cue.  But one thing's for sure, since their souls are tied to each other neither one of them have been able to move on.  Now a bickering pair of ghosts, Henry and Savannah need to work together if they want to have any chance of undoing their eternal union.

hero_trapper_lore.text: An employee of the New York Municipal Coven; Trapper spends his days building Spirit Urns, luring giant rats, and capturing various invasive species from The Outer Planes.  It's not a particularly glamorous job, and he really hates working with spiders, but those Knickerbocker season tickets don't pay for themselves.

hero_operative_lore.text:
Led by the specter of Catherine the Great, the Soviet Empire has flourished in a brave new world of mysticism.  But while her deeper motivations are often obfuscated from the world stage, one thing is for certain: she hates being a ghost.  To this end she has tasked The Empire’s spymaster with one goal: find a way to make her corporeal once more.

Relentless in pursuit of his task; the operative known only as "The Raven" has scoured the Earth looking for strange artifacts, apocryphal writings, and wisdom of the life beyond. Now in New York, Raven looks to find a way to tether Catherine’s spirit to the mortal coil.

hero_vampirebat_lore.text:
Mina Ha had it all...rich parents, elite education, and an arranged marriage that would see her ascend from run-of-the-mill upper class to American royalty.  She was happy.

Then her betrothed was assassinated.

Mina wept; not for the life of her fiancé, but for the future that was stolen from her.  Why couldn’t the killer just wait until after the wedding? Then she’d have the last name she always dreamed of and no one would even have to pretend to love anyone.  It could have been perfect, but life wasn’t fair...and so Mina did what she always does when things don’t go her way: she told her parents to fix it.

Mr. And Mrs. Ha knew that the only way to appease their daughter was to offer her something greater than what she lost... and marrying into one of the world’s most lauded families was a tall order to top.  They had to think big.  They had to think outside of the box.  They had to promise their daughter immortality.

It took a small fortune, but eventually they found a vampire who was willing to turn her.  Unsurprisingly, Mina thought the idea of eternal youth and a trust fund was an acceptable plan B and happily agreed to the proposal.  Now a fledgling vampire, Mina is quickly discovering that the clout she held as a human has no weight in vampire high society...and while at first that annoyed her, if there is one thing Mina has a knack for, it's learning the rules so she can subvert them.  She will be the Viscount of New York, the other vampires just don't know it yet.

hero_punkgoat_lore.text:
Billy is a white hot ball of rage, furious at the very notion of...something.  Maybe it’s the cops.  Maybe it’s magic regulations.  Maybe it’s the service at the gyro place downtown.  (Not the good one.  The other one.)

Don't ask him how he got the goat head.

hero_doorman_lore.text:
He's proper, he's polite, but the humble Doorman of The Baroness Hotel is more than meets the eye.

While he had only planned to experience life on this plane for a few weeks, The Doorman quickly discovered that the New York service industry was a great way to see the strange demands that please humans.

hero_familiar_lore.text:
An accidental stowaway from the world of dreams, Rem has found himself stranded in the city that never sleeps.  Driven by his curious nature, Rem and his helpful friends have been seen wandering across the five boroughs in search of a way back home.

So if you ever find yourself dozing off while taking the Blue line home from work, maybe you’ve just had an encounter with one of the Cursed Apple’s newest denizens.

hero_necro_lore.text:
The daughter of high-power defense attorneys, Darcy Graves grew up in a home where every conversation was a debate, argument, or negotiation. It was exhausting. But while her parents were often too busy meeting with clients or working on cases to bond with her, the dead were always there to listen.

Graves enjoyed her time in the cemetery.  It was a quiet place to calm her thoughts and talk through her problems...but one day her one-sided conversations started to change.

It began with a faint whisper.  A woman's voice that seemed to respond to Graves' complaints.  Intrigued, the teenager listened...and followed the voice's instructions until it guided her to a lead-lined box buried in Van Cortlandt Park.  But while most high school students would freak out if they were to unearth a severed lich hand, Graves was certainly not most teens.  The hand now free of its prison, the lich's voice grew stronger... It had spent years looking to find a student she could pass her knowledge to, and Graves was eager to learn.

Now a fledgling necromancer, Darcy balances not only her homework at Blackmore Academy...but the demands of graveyard denizens, each of whom have their own unfinished business that they seek her aid in resolving.

hero_werewolf_lore.text: Lilah Silver is a mess.  She drinks too much, she smokes too much, and the less is said about her personal life the better.   But despite Silver's flaws she has managed to carve out a career as a successful bounty hunter, and while she would like to think that her successes are solely because she has incredible intuition, the fact that she’s a werewolf doesn’t hurt.

hero_priest_lore.text:
The Venators of St. Benedict are a Vatican-sanctioned order whose members are deployed to regions with a high concentration of supernatural predators.   Few in number, their modus operandi is to observe, identify, and exterminate. They are methodical, they are precise, and once they identify a threat to the flock they are relentless.

But even amongst those who are called The Sword Of St. Benedict, one stands apart from the others.  A man whose hardened heart has allowed him to pay terrible prices in the name of the greater good... and he has once again been dispatched to New York.

hero_unicorn_lore.text:
Even in a world of magic, some things are still rare and unusual. So what is a unicorn to do?  Announce her presence to the world and potentially have poachers looking to saw off her horn? Or hide in plain sight at a Coney Island Side Show where most folk would assume her appearance was just part of an act?

Over the years "The Dazzling Celeste" has grown into one of the more popular attractions on Coney, and while the applause from a cheering audience is appreciated; what keeps her waking up in the morning is the found family she's made at work.

Keruba the Mermaid.

Blockhead Lenny.

Chickenwing.

Ted.

These were her people.  So when she discovered that one of her own sold part of their soul in order to cover a gambling debt, Celeste knew it was time to step out of the shadows and do whatever it takes to get it back.  Is revealing her power to The Patrons a risk?  Yes.  But that's tomorrow's problem... her family needs help today.

hero_fencer_lore.text:
A land of beauty, tradition and conflict; North Ixia is no stranger to brutal political violence. So when Apollo was told that it was for his own safety he was being sent to New York for school, he knew the situation was serious.

Adjusting to life at Blackmore Academy didn’t come easy to Apollo. His school was supposed to be filled with The Cursed Apple’s best and brightest but all he saw, with few exceptions, was a sea of aggressive mediocrity. Electing not to waste his time with frivolous things like parties and dances, he instead put his energy on the piste, where he rigorously trains as captain of the Blackmore fencing team.

However, at the end of the day Apollo does not fret too much on the tedium of life in New York. He knows that eventually the time will come when his father will call on him to come home and he will get to show that he is worthy of wielding his family's ancestral blade.

You must also have at least {d:required_hero_unlocks} {d:required_hero_unlocks, plural, one {hero} other {heroes}} with {d:required_hero_wins} {d:required_hero_wins, plural, one {win} other {wins}} on each in Standard Mode.

Players are only allowed to queue up for ranked as a Solo or Duo. Duo parties must be within 1 Rank up or down from each other. Eternus players can only queue with other Eternus players who are within 3 subranks of each other.
You must complete {d:required_solo_calibration_games} solo calibration games. The max rank you can exit calibration with is {g:citadel_packed_rank_name:max_calibration_rank}.

Citadel_Ranked_Overview_Playing_Bullet1.text: Each win/loss will grant you +/- {d:ranked_point_gain} points on average. These numbers may vary slightly depending on the expectations the matchmaker had from that game, or from win streaks. You will see your Rank Points update with a visible progress bar after each match.

Citadel_Ranked_Overview_Playing_Bullet2.text: When you are promoted to a new Rank or Subrank, you earn Demotion Protection tokens. For full badge Rank ups, you earn 5 tokens and for each Subrank you earn 2. If you lose while Demotion Protection is active, and you would have gone down a Rank, you instead stay the same Rank and a token is consumed.

Citadel_Ranked_Overview_Playing_Bullet3.text: To advance from one Subrank to the next, you need to earn 1,000 Rank Points (ex. {g:citadel_packed_rank_name:'62'} -> {g:citadel_packed_rank_name:'63'}). To advance between a full badge Rank to the next, you will need to earn 2,000 Rank Points (ex. {g:citadel_packed_rank_name:'56'} -> {g:citadel_packed_rank_name:'61'}).

Citadel_Ranked_Overview_Playing_Bullet4.text: At the highest Rank, the rules change slightly. You still gain or lose Rank points the same as before, but the Subranks are no longer fixed-point amounts. Instead, once a day, Subranks are assigned according to the percentiles of players within the {g:citadel_packed_rank_rank_name:'111'} Rank.

Citadel_Ranked_Overview_Hero_Bullet1.text: Once you enter a new Ranked Match, you will see a breakdown of the ranks of all players in the game, you will then enter a pre-game waiting area.

Citadel_Ranked_Overview_Hero_Bullet2.text: You can choose to change your hero to improve your team composition or swap lanes with allies.

Citadel_LeaderboardRankDesc.text: At {g:citadel_packed_rank_name:leaderboard_packed_rank} and higher, badges are no longer gained by receiving a fixed amounts of points. Instead, all eligible players are placed in order according to rank points, and then assigned their badge based on their percentile position.

citadel_settings_ssao_desc.text:
Approximates soft contact shadowing using screen space data.

Performance cost: moderate/consistent.

citadel_settings_post_bloom_desc.text:
Bleeds light from brighter parts of the image to simulate imperfections in camera lenses, to give a visual cue for high brightness.

Performance cost: small/consistent

citadel_settings_effects_bloom_desc.text:
Allows us to draw effects directly into the bloom buffer to enhanced visuals.

Performance cost: small/consistent

citadel_settings_fxaa_desc.text:
Reduces stair-stepping artifacts from undersampling the image. Antialiasing is WIP - we currently support FXAA.

Performance cost: small/consistent

citadel_settings_fsr2_desc.text: WIP Integration of AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 2 Temporal AA/Upscaling

citadel_settings_area_lights_desc.text:
Allows large or irregularly shaped light sources, such as beam effects, to be rendered correctly. Performance cost could be higher on low-end systems.

Performance cost: small/consistent

citadel_settings_depth_of_field_desc.text:
Simulates varying camera lens focal length and aperture. Should not affect gameplay performance in its current state.

Performance cost: negligible

citadel_settings_displacement_mapping_de.text:
Screen space displacement effect for higher fidelity bumps on world geometry.

Performance cost: moderate/consistent

citadel_settings_mboit_desc.text: WIP feature allowing effects to render more consistently, and eventually at lower resolution than the rest of the frame.

citadel_settings_vsync_desc.text: Eliminates screen tearing artifacts but increases input latency.

citadel_settings_dfao_desc.text:
Approximates soft contact shadowing from characters and dynamic objects using distance field data.

Performance cost: moderate/varies

citadel_settings_fogquality_desc.text: Lower settings reduce volumetric fog resolution to improve performance on lower-end systems.

citadel_settings_texturequality_desc.text: Lower settings reduce texture resolution to possibly improve performance on lower-end systems.

citadel_settings_shadow_quality_desc.text: Lower settings reduce shadow rendering quality to improve performance on lower-end systems.

citadel_settings_upscaling_desc.text:
Generates high resolution frames from low resolution, faster-to-render internal frames.

FSR2 uses temporal anti-aliasing (TAA).

Performance cost: moderate/consistent

citadel_settings_antialiasing_desc.text:
Post-process anti-aliasing effect to use when FSR2 is disabled.

Performance cost: small/consistent

citadel_settings_particlequality_desc.text: Cull unnecessary parts of effects for better performance. Not currently used.

citadel_settings_fsr_rcas_sharpness_desc.text: Adjust the strength of the sharpness filter applied to increase the clarity of the FSR-upscaled screen image.

citadel_settings_renderquality_desc.text: Per-dimension scaling ratio for calculating internal render resolution. Lower values render faster. Higher values render sharper with fewer artifacts.

citadel_settings_fsr2scaling_desc.text: FSR scaling boosts frame rates by rendering fewer pixels. Higher scaling rates lowers the native resolution, but renders faster.

citadel_settings_fsr2_sharpness_desc.text: Adjust the strength of the sharpness filter applied to increase the clarity of the FSR-upscaled screen image.

citadel_settings_dlssscaling_desc.text:
Super Resolution boosts frame rates by rendering fewer pixels and using AI to output high resolution frames. This feature requires a GeForce RTX graphics card

Higher scaling rates lowers the native resolution, but renders faster.

CNN is the current default model using Convolutional Neural Networks

Transformer is the newer beta model released with DLSS4, sharper and more accurate especially at higher scaling ratios, but also more expensive.
