guide_overview_desc.text: Explore the various sections to learn about the game.

guide_the_map_welcome_desc.text: Welcome to The Cursed Apple. If your team wants to emerge victorious, you’ll need to wield both guns and supernatural powers to lay siege to the enemy base.

guide_the_map_desc.text: Hover over areas on the map to learn more about the things you'll see while playing Deadlock.

guide_the_map_lanes_desc.text: There are three lanes, each with a zipline that players can ride to move quickly.

guide_the_map_guardians_desc.text: Guardians are the first line of defense in each lane. Their attacks are very powerful, so it's best to push into them with your troopers.

guide_the_map_walkers_desc.text: Walkers lie deeper in the lanes and have an arsenal of defensive moves.

guide_the_map_troopers_desc.text: Troopers periodically spawn in the base and then run down a lane, fighting any enemies they encounter.

guide_the_map_core_desc.text: There is a shrine at the back of each team's base. Destroying the enemy shrine wins the game.

guide_the_map_core_alt_desc.text: Your goal is to siege the enemy base, and destroy their defenses to reveal their team's Patron.  Destroy the Patron, and victory is yours.

guide_the_map_midboss_desc.text: The middle of the map has a powerful neutral boss. The team that kills it will have immediate respawns on their next deaths.

guide_upgrades_last_hit_desc.text:
Get Souls by killing troopers and players. You can also get Souls by killing neutrals located throughout the map.

Souls are shared among allies nearby.

guide_upgrades_yellow_orbs_desc.text:
When an enemy dies, extra souls appear.

You can secure these Souls by shooting the blue orb containing them or letting them float away.

guide_upgrades_deny_desc.text:
Enemy Soul Orbs are orange and enemies will get them if they float away or if they shoot them.

You can shoot these Orange Orbs first to steal them.

guide_upgrades_killing_guardians_desc.text:
As you collect souls, you'll also be granted Ability Points (AP).

You can spend these points to upgrade your abilities by holding {g:citadel_binding:'Scoreboard'}

guide_upgrades_going_home_desc.text:
When you have souls to spend, go back to base to heal and buy powerful items that increase your stats and grant additional abilities.

There's also a shop next to each guardian, available until the guardian is destroyed.

guide_upgrades_upgrade_abilities_desc.text:
Spend Ability Points to upgrade your abilities.

Abilities have three upgrade tiers.

guide_upgrades_buy_mods_desc.text:
Items can modify a variety of things like ammo count, melee damage or health regeneration. Items that increase Spirit Power improve the effectiveness of your abilities.

There is a Suggested Items tab with hand-picked recommendations for each hero.

guide_neutrals_desc.text:
There are many neutral creatures lurking around the map. Defeat them to earn souls.

Sometimes, a powerful creature will appear at the center of the map… defeating it will offer your team great power.

guide_movement_slide_desc.text: Hold {g:citadel_binding:'Crouch'} to slide while moving down a ramp or moving at high speed.

guide_movement_dodge_desc.text:
While moving press {g:citadel_binding:'Roll'} to dash.

Requires stamina.

guide_movement_zipline_desc.text:
Hold {g:citadel_binding:'Zipline'} to get on the line.

You can jump off by pressing {g:citadel_binding:'Mantle'}

guide_movement_mantle_desc.text: Hold {g:citadel_binding:'Mantle'} when near a ledge to mantle up.

guide_movement_double_jump_desc.text:
Press {g:citadel_binding:'Mantle'} while in midair to double jump.

Special moves like double jump use your stamina bar, located below your reticle.

guide_movement_airdash_desc.text:
While airborne, {g:citadel_binding:'Roll'} to perform an air dash.

Requires stamina.

guide_movement_dodge_jump_desc.text:
Combine a dash and a well-timed jump to perform a dash jump.

Requires stamina.

guide_basics_shoot_desc.text:
Press {g:citadel_binding:'Attack'} to shoot.

Gun damage falls off at longer ranges.

guide_basics_aim_desc.text: Hold {g:citadel_binding:'ADS'} to zoom in with your weapon.

guide_basics_melee_desc.text: Press {g:citadel_binding:'AbilityMelee'} to make a quick attack. Hold {g:citadel_binding:'AbilityMelee'} to deliver a powerful charging attack.

guide_basics_reload_desc.text: Press {g:citadel_binding:'Reload'} to reload your weapon. Certain actions, such as melee, will pause reload.

guide_advanced_parry_desc.text:
Press {g:citadel_binding:'HeldItem'} to parry an enemy's melee attack.

They will be stunned and will receive increased melee damage.

guide_basics_abilities_desc.text: Press {g:citadel_binding:'Ability1'}, {g:citadel_binding:'Ability2'}, {g:citadel_binding:'Ability3'}, {g:citadel_binding:'Ability4'} to use your hero's abilities.

Citadel_ranked_explainer_desc.text:
Ranked is a challenge mode that provides a more competitive Deadlock experience where you'll be matchmade with players of similar skill to determine your Skill Rank among the global population.

Each week, players can choose to join this competition by playing Ranked matches during their region's open time periods to demonstrate their individual skill.

Citadel_Profile_Skill_Rating_Intro.text: Skill Rating is measurement of a player's recent and historical performance.

Citadel_ranked_howitworks_desc.text:
All players start with the provisional Skill Rating of Obscurus until enough matches have been played to calibrate.

There are eleven different Skill Rating tiers, and within each tier, players will also be assigned a level from I to , which further distinguishes their position within that tier.

Each individual hero is assigned a matchmaking weighting relative to a player's Core Skill Rating (as indicated by arrows).

Unplayed heroes will always begin with lower relative weightings to your Core Skill Rating.

Skill Rating updates immediately post-match.

Only you can see your Skill Rating.
